people.imagined: Noon in the desert at the well. He measures the water in his cupped hand by the mouthful, squinting under a white hood, and has just noticed a rider.
people.subject: The moment: noon in the desert at a stone well-head; the captain of the guard lets a thin stream of water pour from his cupped palm, counting it by the mouthful, and squints hard at the viewer over it, having just spotted a rider. Face: a hard, wind-cut face of fifty the colour of tanned saddle-leather; eyes narrowed to two dark slits, the squint carved into deep crow's-feet that run to the temples; a short broken nose; a thick grey-flecked moustache over a thin callous mouth; a salt-white crust at the corners of the lips; a sunburnt peeling scar across the forehead. Hair: iron-grey, cropped almost to the scalp, mostly hidden under a pale hood. Body: broad, square and heavy-shouldered, hardened by sun; stands with weight on his heels and arms loose. Clothing: an undyed white robe of fine cloth with a dusty hem, over which a pale-blue guard's sash is tied across the chest; a hooded white desert cloak thrown back from the head; leather arm-guards laced to the elbow; a wide belt; tall dust-grey boots; no ornament at all. Hands and objects: the left hand cupped, water trickling out between the fingers and falling in a bright thread; the right resting on the hilt of a plain straight sword, the leather grip dark from sweat. Background: white sand, a round stone well-head with a rope and bucket, one camel's long neck blurred, a thin wavering horizon. Light: hard white noon from the upper left, black shadow under the brow, the water a bright glint. Expression: callous, watchful and loyal; no smile, a man who has buried many raiders and counts water as treasure.

people.imagined: Night in the burial glacier. She is speaking to the standing dead in a whisper so low that they seem to lean in; her cuffs are black from lamp soot.
people.subject: The moment: night inside the burial glacier; she lifts a small brass lamp beside a row of standing dead sealed in ice, speaking in a whisper so low that they seem to lean in, and turns her face softly to the viewer, lips barely parted. Face: a small, old, pale, gentle face of sixty; deep fine wrinkles like cracks in porcelain; very large calm dark eyes; thin soft mouth; a straight small nose; frost crystals on her lashes and on a few wisps at her temples. Hair: white, parted in the middle and drawn into a low bun, held by a white-jade pin shaped like a thin icicle. Body: slight, narrow and a little bent, as if leaning to listen. Clothing: an inner robe of white silk with a crossed collar; over it a white elder's robe of fine cloth, wide-sleeved, unembroidered; a frost-silk sash that glitters and looks cold; both cuffs black with lamp soot, big and plain against the white; a shawl of white fur over the shoulders; felt slippers. Hands and objects: a small brass lamp with a pinpoint flame held at breast height in both hands, soot on the thumbs. Background: blurred pale figures frozen upright in blue ice, facing away to the south, in a row that recedes into dark. Light: cold blue light from the ice around her, the lamp's warm point lighting her chin from below. Expression: serene, devout and reclusive; the stillness of someone among friends.

people.imagined: Late at night at his desk, he has just found a bill in his own hand counted twice, and licks his thumb to check it again.
people.subject: The moment: late at night at his desk, the treasurer has found a bill counted twice in his own hand; he licks a thumb to check the sum again, holds the page up to the lamp and looks sharply over its edge at the viewer. Face: a narrow, grey-yellow face of fifty-five with sunken cheeks; small sharp eyes set close together; a long thin nose; a pinched mouth drawn tight like a purse-string, the lips moving faintly as if tasting the total. Hair: thin grey hair scraped back flat into a tight knot, held by a plain bone pin. Body: thin, stooped and narrow in the chest, shoulders hunched over the desk. Clothing: a white treasurer's robe of fine cloth, spotless and exactly fitted, with a frost-silk sash knotted tight; fur-lined cuffs with the pelt cropped short and plain; a small bone abacus hanging from the sash on a cord; soft wool slippers. Hands and objects: a blank slip of paper held to the lamp between two thumbs and fingertips stained black with ink and counting, shown plainly in the foreground; a brush in a stand and a stone ink-slab on the desk before him. Background: a dark room, bundles of paper slips tied with cord stacked on a shelf, a brass lamp, a cold stove. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left against deep dark, catching the sharp bones of his face. Expression: a tight, suspicious, calculating stare, the brows pulled in and the mouth working silently, a man who trusts no figure, least of all his own.

people.imagined: On the harbour at dawn, laughing at something a boatman said, his flattened nose giving the laugh a wet, loud tone that carries across the water.
people.subject: The moment: on the harbour at dawn he laughs at something a boatman said, and the flattened nose gives the laugh a wet, loud tone that carries across the water; he stands on the bow of a skiff, one hand on the mast, head thrown back, then looks down at the viewer with a bright cruel eye. Face: a heavy, square, red-brown face of fifty-five; a nose flattened flat against the face from an old blow, plain; a wide laughing mouth showing a gap; small hard blue eyes; a grey-stubbled jaw; deep laugh lines. Hair: grizzled grey-black, tied back in a short tail with a cord. Body: huge-chested, short-necked and very strong, legs apart on the boards. Clothing: a white outer robe cut short for the boat, tucked into a frost-silk sash bright with salt; a coast-blue lining flashing at the cuff; heavy sealskin boots turned over at the knee; a short sealskin cape. Hands and objects: one hand on a wet mast, knuckles scarred; the other holds a long dark boat-hook with an iron point. Background: a grey harbour, other skiffs with brown sails, shelves of ice at the edge. Light: cold bright dawn from the upper left, spray glitter. Expression: loud, gregarious and warlike; the laugh does not reach the eyes.

people.imagined: Deep under the seat, she places her palm on a cold node and hums a single note until it answers; her left sleeve is pinned back.
people.subject: The moment: deep under the seat, in a tunnel of the Jade Vessel Array, she places her bare left palm on a cold blue node and hums a single note until the stone answers; her left sleeve is pinned back; her eyes slide to the viewer. Face: a narrow, careful, pale face of thirty-eight; dark eyes that give nothing; thin level brows; a small straight nose; a slightly pursed mouth; a faint line between the brows; a trace of chalk on one cheek. Hair: black, in one tight braid pinned in a coil at the nape. Body: slim, composed and very still, leaning a little toward the node. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with the left sleeve pinned back above the elbow by a plain silver pin, big and plain; the pale-blue inner-disciple sash; a dusting of chalk on the hem; soft felt boots. Hands and objects: the bare left hand flat on a round pale-blue carved stone that glows faintly; a stub of white chalk in her right; a lamp at her foot. Background: a low stone tunnel with a ring of faint blue lights fading into the dark; a footprint brushed from the dust. Light: cold blue light from the stone beneath her hand, from below and the left. Expression: careful, patient and quietly hiding something.

people.imagined: On the glacier path, she nods politely to empty air as the standing dead go by, frost forming on her pale lashes.
people.subject: The moment: on the glacier path, she nods politely to empty air as the standing dead go by, with frost forming on her pale lashes; she stops and looks up at the viewer. Face: a pale, delicate face of thirty-two; large grey eyes with long lashes furred with frost, big and plain; a small, soft mouth; high cheekbones; a calm brow; a faint pink at the tip of the nose; the breath from her lips is a thin white plume, and a tiny crust of frost has formed on one eyebrow. Hair: long and black, loose down the back, tied with a pale-blue ribbon at the nape. Body: slender and upright, hands before her, the bow just finished. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a high crossed collar and a pale-blue sash; a white wool shawl over the shoulders; no jewellery; white leggings and felt boots. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front of her, a small white lamp held in them with a thin flame; breath smoking from her lips. Background: blue ice walls and the faint shapes of standing figures sealed in ice, facing south. Light: soft blue light from the upper left, a warm point from the lamp. Expression: calm, devout and humble; she is at ease among the dead.

people.imagined: In the hall she touches the jade pin in her sleek braids, furious again, her eyes on a frost-coast disciple across the room.
people.subject: The moment: in the hall she touches the jade pin in her sleek braids, furious again, her eyes fixed on a frost-coast disciple across the room; she raises two fingers to the pin and glares at the viewer, chin high. Face: a sharp, handsome, hard face of thirty-six; slanted dark eyes; thin, perfectly arched brows; a thin red-pink mouth set in contempt; a small sharp nose; flawless pale skin with high colour at the cheekbones. Hair: glossy black, plaited into two sleek braids coiled up and fixed with a long jade pin, big and plain, a few pale-blue silk threads in the plait. Body: tall, rigid and narrow-shouldered, held like a blade. Clothing: an inner robe of white silk with a high collar; over it a white robe of the finest cloth with a pale-blue sash, perfectly pressed; no embroidery; the cuffs exact and straight; pale slippers. Hands and objects: two fingers on the jade pin at her temple; a plain white sword at her left hip; fine nails. Background: a pale hall of white pillars, dim, with the shapes of other disciples at a distance. Light: cold light from the upper left, a glint on the jade. Expression: arrogant, cruel and loyal to one person only.

people.imagined: Practice hall, late. He swings the white-wrapped palms in the Snow Plum forms again; the wraps have bled through by evening.
people.subject: The moment: in the practice hall, late; he has just finished drilling the Snow Plum forms again, and he holds out both hands before him, palms up, wrapped in white strips with blood showing through, then looks at the viewer. Face: a long, grim, dark-browed face of forty-two; deep-set black eyes; a tight jaw clenched; a short stubbled chin; a vertical furrow in the forehead; sweat; a small white scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, tied in a tight topknot, a few loose strands stuck to his temples. Body: lean, upright and rigid with restraint; his shoulders are loose but his neck cords stand out. Clothing: a white sword-hall robe of fine cloth, sleeves cut narrow; a pale-blue sash; clean and well pressed apart from sweat at the collar; white leggings; plain shoes. Hands and objects: both palms wrapped in white cloth strips, the cloth stained rust-red through, in the foreground; a plain white-bladed sword on a rack behind; the blood on the wraps is dark at the centre of each palm and brighter at the edge; the sword rack behind holds one empty peg where a white-bladed sword is missing. Background: a plain sword hall with a polished floor, a rack of swords, a window of dusk; beside him on the polished floor a puddle of sweat has formed. Light: slanting evening light from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, wrathful and silent.

people.imagined: At the Beast Hall door a big white ice wolf leans on his hip; he is half asleep standing and takes the praise of the hall with a lazy grin.
people.subject: The moment: at the Beast Hall door a big white-maned ice wolf leans on his hip; he is half asleep standing, and takes the praise of the hall with a lazy grin as he looks at the viewer. Face: a handsome, relaxed face of forty; half-lidded easy eyes; a lopsided grin; a day's stubble; fine laugh lines; a faint pink at the nose; the wolf's mane is as high as his ribs and its pale eyes half closed in pleasure. Hair: black, loose and a little unkempt to the shoulder, white wolf hairs caught in it; its coat is brushed to a silken shine by someone else's hand, and a brush with white hair in it lies on the step. Body: tall, loose-limbed and leaning, one knee clicking slightly as he shifts; his left knee is bent in the awkward way that clicks, and he leans his weight on the wolf instead. Clothing: a white riding robe, short in the skirt, with white wolf hair clinging to both sleeves in clear drifts; a pale-blue sash; fur-lined boots; leather riding gloves tucked in the belt. Hands and objects: one hand buried in the white wolf's thick ruff; the other holds a stirrup-cup; a younger rider in the doorway behind him, with owl feathers by his ear, is carrying a bucket. Background: a pale-blue stone yard, the wolf's flank, a barred door. Light: cold clear light from the upper left. Expression: lazy, gregarious and fickle; pleased at the credit.

people.imagined: By the rod-house stove, writing in her thunder log with soot freckled on her nose; a second book under her sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: by the rod-house stove, writing in her thunder log with soot freckled on her nose and a second book under her sleeve; she looks up with a flat polite smile. Face: a small round face of thirty-two with soot freckles across the nose and cheeks, big and plain; bright quick brown eyes; a small mouth; short brows; a dimple; a thin line of soot runs along her jaw where she has rubbed it, and her hand holding the brush is steady. Hair: brown, in two buns on top, tied with pale-blue ribbon. Body: small, neat, sitting straight; the trimmed log is in the book on her knee and the hidden one is tied with a red thread. Clothing: a white working robe of fine cloth, sleeves tied back; a pale-blue sash; a copper rod tucked in the sash; a leather apron with ash marks; a mug of tea steams on the stove top, and her felt slippers are scorched at the toes. Hands and objects: a brush in her right hand; a book open on her knee; the corner of a second book under her sleeve; fingers inked. Background: a small hut, a red stove glow, copper rods on the wall, a rain-streaked window; above the stove a row of three copper rods hangs, each tipped with a blue-black scorch. Light: warm stove glow from the lower left, cool light from the upper left. Expression: cautious, content and deceitful.

people.imagined: In the great kitchen of the glacier seat with four hundred bowls to fill and no flame to cook with; he counts barley under his breath and glances at a sack set aside.
people.subject: The moment: in the great kitchen of the glacier seat with four hundred bowls to fill and no flame to cook with; he counts barley under his breath and glances at a sack set aside, then looks up cheerfully at the viewer. Face: a round, ruddy, jolly face of forty-five with a double chin; bright small shrewd eyes; a wide mouth; barley dust in his eyebrows; a flat nose; his chins wobble when he nods. Hair: thinning brown hair in a small knot. Body: stout, short and round-bellied; a steam-curl rises from the cauldron beside his left shoulder and a thin kitchen boy carries a ladle. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a stained apron over it; a frost-silk sash straining at the middle; sleeves rolled to forearms; wooden clogs; the sack at his foot has a better grain, white and plump, and is tied with a green cord, and he has put one boot casually against it. Hands and objects: a wooden ladle in his right hand; the left counting on four fingers; a sack of barley set apart at his foot; four hundred wooden bowls are stacked in towers on a long table behind him. Background: a hall of steaming qi-heated cauldrons, rows of bowls, sacks; his big belly is dusted with barley flour in a pale handprint. Light: warm steamy light from the upper left. Expression: pragmatic, greedy and gregarious.

people.imagined: In her warm hut at night with an injured sable on her lap, she smooths its fur; a crooked finger shows.
people.subject: The moment: in her warm hut at night with an injured sable on her lap, she smooths its fur and looks up gently at the viewer. Face: a quiet, long, fine face of thirty-eight; soft dark eyes; a gentle mouth; one little scar on the chin; a pink flush from the warmth; its eyes are black beads; her sleeves are pushed up showing thin forearms with old bite-scars. Hair: long black hair in two braids with a few white sable hairs stuck in them; her hair has white wisps stuck to it with straw dust, and her braids hang forward over her shoulders. Body: slim, patient and bent over her work. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a thick sable-fur collar, a pale-blue sash, sleeves loose; wool slippers. Hands and objects: her right hand strokes the sable; the little finger of that hand is crooked, bitten once, plainly shown; a bowl of warm milk. Background: a warm hut, straw, a small lamp, a row of small cages; the sable in her lap is a pale cream-white with a bandaged hind foot; two other kits sleep in a basket by the stove; a small jar of salve and a roll of clean bandage lie on the straw; the hut's roof is low and hung with dried herbs and furs. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Expression: compassionate, reclusive and patient.

people.imagined: At the skiff's tiller in a rising storm, a pale scar across his chin white with salt, grinning because he would row it into the storm if asked.
people.subject: The moment: at the skiff's tiller in a rising storm, a pale scar across his chin white with salt; he grips the tiller in a spray-dashed skiff and grins at the viewer, braced against the wind. Face: a broad square face of forty; a salt-white scar across the chin, plain and bright; fearless light eyes; windburnt cheeks; wet black stubble; a wet black beard of spray drips from his chin; behind him the skiff's brown sail is half reefed, and a boy hauls on a line; a lantern lashed to the mast swings, unlit in the grey day; the salt scar on his chin shines whiter than his teeth, and his boots have iron cleats. Hair: black, short, plastered with spray. Body: shoulders as broad as a door, huge arms, braced on wide-set legs. Clothing: a white short outer robe soaked grey, a pale-blue sash, a sealskin cloak flung back; high waterproof boots; his forearms are knotted with ropy veins and his sleeves are pushed to the elbow. Hands and objects: both hands on a tiller, knuckles white; a coil of wet rope at his feet. Background: a heaving grey sea and ice, the black bows of two other skiffs; the tiller is of black oak scored with notches. Light: flat grey stormlight from the upper left, a hard white glint of spray. Expression: brave, impatient and loyal.

people.imagined: In the Desert Pavilion's courtyard, receiving a caravan factor and noticing again the way the seat's disciples listen to her accent.
people.subject: The moment: in the Desert Pavilion's courtyard, receiving a caravan factor and noticing again the way the seat's disciples listen to her accent; she bows politely toward the viewer with her sash sitting a little high at the waist, smiling humbly. Face: a round warm-brown face of thirty-five; large gentle dark eyes; a quick shy smile; a small gold stud in one nostril, big enough to see. Hair: black, parted and braided with a few bright harbour beads at the end; her hair beads are green and red glass. Body: short, sturdy and upright; behind her a young disciple glances over a shoulder and murmurs to another. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash tied a little higher than the Pavilion way; a thin desert veil at her neck; sandals; the sash's high knot is of pale-blue silk tied twice; a camel kneels at the edge of the frame with a woven saddle-cloth of harbour stripes. Hands and objects: hands folded in front of the sash; a small cloth purse at her wrist; she folds her hands as if used to being watched, and a small bronze bell on her wrist tinkles when she bows. Background: a sand-coloured courtyard, an awning, camels blurred; the awning throws a sharp-edged band of shade across her feet. Light: warm desert light from the upper left. Expression: humble, diligent and trusting.

people.imagined: On the caravan road, upright as his banner pole, with the white banner furled and dust-free; he checks its hem and a dent on his thumb shows.
people.subject: The moment: on the caravan road, upright as his banner pole, with the white banner furled and dust-free; he checks its hem, then glances at the viewer. Face: a straight-nosed, correct, handsome face of forty-two; a thin neat moustache; narrow eyes with a hint of falseness; chin lifted; behind, a young guard with a split lip brushes dust from a different hem. Hair: black, oiled, neatly knotted. Body: straight as a post, shoulders squared. Clothing: a white guard's robe pressed and clean, a pale-blue sash; leather arm-guards; a plain cloak; boots polished against the dust; the white banner is wrapped in oilcloth and tied with three neat knots; the hem of the white banner, visible at the bottom, is pristine, with not a grain of sand on it; his boots are dusted pale to the ankle but his robe is spotless. Hands and objects: both hands on a pole with a brass cap; his right thumb has a dented pad where the cap rests, plain; the pole carries a furled plain white banner with no emblem; the brass cap on the pole has a thumb-sized worn dent, bright from his grip. Background: sand and a dim caravan wagon with a bundled cloth; behind him a baggage wagon has a bundled shape that is the banner's real resting place. Light: bright desert light from the upper left. Expression: brave, stubborn and vain.

people.imagined: Writing the coast's judgements, a calligrapher's reed-pen in his hand, a cup of tea going cold at his elbow; he decides by mood and does not know it.
people.subject: The moment: writing the coast's judgements with a calligrapher's pen, a cup of tea going cold at his elbow; he pauses with a long brush over a sheet and looks calmly at the viewer, ink to the second knuckle on his fingers. Face: a long, composed, scholarly face of forty-eight; patient half-lidded eyes; a thin moustache and a wisp of chin beard; fine smooth skin; the tea cup beside him has a skin on it and has been cold for an hour; a faint smile tightens one corner of his mouth as he decides on mood. Hair: grey-black, in a neat topknot with a dark wooden pin. Body: thin, upright and deliberate. Clothing: a white scholar's robe of fine cloth with long sleeves, a pale-blue sash; the right cuff black with ink; soft slippers. Hands and objects: a long brush in the right hand, fingers black with ink to the second knuckle, large and plain; a cup of tea; the writing sheet before him is blank, with a single stroke of ink just begun, a long clean curve; his long fingers are tipped with square pale nails, black at the first two knuckles; a bamboo brush-rest shows a row of seven brushes sorted by size; on the wall behind him hangs a scroll of plain pale paper with no writing. Background: a quiet study, a screen, a stack of sheets. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: arbitrary, patient and honest.

people.imagined: Copying a letter at night in the envoy's study, ink at the corner of her mouth, she lifts her eyes at a footstep.
people.subject: The moment: copying a letter at night in the envoy's study, ink at the corner of her mouth, she lifts her eyes at a footstep; she turns quickly over her shoulder from a desk with a brush in her hand, a heavy braid swinging. Face: a sharp, pretty, ambitious face of thirty; bright watchful eyes; a small smile that comes too fast; a smudge of ink at the corner of the mouth, plain; the ink on her lip is faintly wet. Hair: a very heavy black braid pinned over the left shoulder; a dark hair-pin of black wood holds the end of her braid, which swings as she turns. Body: slim and quick. Clothing: a white robe with a pale-blue sash, neat; narrow sleeves tied back; behind her a half-open door shows a dark corridor with a sliver of light, and a pair of slippers is just visible there; her sleeve covers the paper she has been copying. Hands and objects: a brush in her hand; a sheet of paper before her (no writing); the lamp is low and the oil is nearly gone. Background: a night study, one lamp; a second copy, a sheet already finished, lies half hidden under a blotter by her elbow. Light: lamplight from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, deceitful and faithless.

people.imagined: At the treasurer's table, reading a column of figures with a finger under each line, lips split and red from the cold.
people.subject: The moment: at the treasurer's table, reading a column of figures with a finger under each line, lips split and red from the cold; she slides a finger under a line, then looks up to the viewer with a guarded, tired glance. Face: a thin tired face of thirty-eight; lips cracked and split by the cold, red at the seams, plain; small watchful eyes; wind-reddened cheeks; the cold has also cracked the skin on her knuckles, and a small piece of cloth is bound round the right forefinger; a brazier at her feet is nearly out, and a thin plume of breath rises from her lips. Hair: brown, tied in a tight bun with a plain cord. Body: thin, narrow and hunched slightly. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash; a clerk's cuff-guards. Hands and objects: one forefinger on a page of figures (no readable writing); a fur-lined glove half off. Background: a counting room, stacks of paper; her desk has a neat pile of green-bound ledgers and one that is out of line; she pushes the page a little away as if guarding a shameful number. Light: dim light from the upper left; behind her, a tall shelf of boxes casts a long shadow. Expression: diligent, paranoid, divided loyalty.

people.imagined: In the ringing hall she bursts into laughter, gap-toothed, as her master Khương Lưu Ly frowns in vain.
people.subject: The moment: in the ringing hall she bursts into laughter, gap-toothed, as her master Khương Lưu Ly frowns in vain; she throws her head back in open laughter showing a gap between her front teeth, then catches the viewer's eye, still grinning. Face: a bright, freckled, fisher's-daughter face of twenty-two; a visible gap in the front teeth; sparkling dark eyes; apple cheeks; dark winged brows; a stern woman in a pressed robe stands blurred at the far end of the hall with her lips pressed together, shaking her head; her cheeks are flushed pink and her eyes crinkle shut at the corners. Hair: black, tied in a high ponytail with a pale-blue ribbon, flying; the laughter has jostled the pale-blue ribbon in her ponytail so one end flies. Body: slim, quick and mid-motion. Clothing: a white sword robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash, sleeves narrow. Hands and objects: one hand on the hilt of a plain white sword at the hip; the other half-raised mid-laugh; a faint chip on her sword's white scabbard shows she is not careful with it. Background: a white-pillared hall, ringing with echoes; the echo of her laugh seems to ring from the white pillars, and a pair of older disciples glance sideways. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: fickle, gregarious and brave.

people.imagined: In the coast quarter's tavern, a white robe worn over the coast's blue lining; the drawl is thick as stew; he is telling a story.
people.subject: The moment: in the coast quarter's tavern, a white robe worn over the coast's blue lining; the drawl is thick as stew; he leans back at a table, one hand raised mid-story, a glint in his eye. Face: a broad, ruddy, quick-grinning face of forty-two; flashing dark eyes; a wide mobile mouth; short stubble; a blue lining flash shows at both wrists and all along the robe's open front. Hair: black, cropped short. Body: stocky, expansive and easy. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth, open, with the coast-blue lining flashing under it, big and plain; a pale-blue sash; behind him a table of coast disciples crowd round a fish stew in a clay pot with steam rising, one of them laughing; his sandals have salt rims. Hands and objects: one hand raised with the palm out; a cup of wine in the other; the lamp over the table is a paper lantern painted with plain blue waves; his hands are broad and warm and he waves one in a rolling gesture as he talks. Background: a lamplit tavern; a wine jug is tipped by his elbow. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Expression: faithless, wrathful and gregarious; a charming smile.

people.imagined: In the burial glacier, he has just finished a niche with a chisel; the dust has whitened his eyebrows.
people.subject: The moment: in the burial glacier, he has just finished a niche with a chisel; the dust has whitened his eyebrows; he taps the chisel against an ice wall and turns his face slowly to the viewer. Face: a stern, deeply lined face of fifty; eyebrows white with chisel dust, big and plain; narrow, stubborn eyes; a heavy square jaw; a flat mouth; the niche beside him is a tall narrow arch cut in blue ice, with a smooth face-forward floor, and its twin stands empty for himself, a little longer and narrower. Hair: iron-grey, short, dusted white. Body: broad-backed and sturdy; fine white dust lies on his shoulders like snow and on the back of his neck. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth, hem dusty, sleeves pushed up; a pale-blue sash; a leather apron. Hands and objects: a short iron chisel and a wooden mallet; his knuckles gritty with ice dust; his square hands show grit in every crease, and the mallet's head is worn to a dark polish. Background: a blue ice wall with half-cut niches; a drift of ice shavings curls on the floor at his feet like pale wood curls; a hooded lantern hangs on a hook at the wall. Light: cold blue light from the upper left. Expression: reclusive, devout and stubborn.

people.imagined: At dawn at the founder's cold well with a bucket, her hem damp; a dried lily bulb pins her pale braid.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn at the founder's cold well with a bucket, her hem damp; she lowers the bucket into a stone well and looks up to the viewer with a content smile. Face: a soft round oasis face of thirty-seven; warm brown skin; peaceful dark eyes; a gentle smile; freckles; the well's stone lip is dark with damp and a little ice-lily bloom shows at its foot, small white cups on thin stems; her sleeves are tucked up showing round forearms with a rope scar. Hair: pale-brown, in a braid pinned up with a dried white lily bulb, big and plain; the dried white lily bulb in her braid is shaped like a small pearl. Body: sturdy, gentle and stooped to the well. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with the hem and lower sleeves dark and damp; a pale-blue sash; her toes in sandals are wet and sandy. Hands and objects: both hands on a wet rope; ice lilies in a pot beside the well; a clay water jar stands next to the bucket. Background: a sandy courtyard with a well-head and small white flowers. Light: gentle dawn light from the upper left; the sun is just coming over a sand dune behind the well, a thin gold line. Expression: content, patient and compassionate.

people.imagined: By the frozen lake, a man five times failed, standing with arms crossed and head high; the crooked nose catches the light.
people.subject: The moment: by the frozen lake, a man five times failed, standing with arms crossed and head high; the crooked nose catches the light as he faces the viewer in defiance. Face: a rough, stubborn face of thirty-eight; a nose broken and set crooked, plain; both ears carrying pale leaf-shaped scars from frostbite, plain; hard dark eyes; a clenched jaw; his feet are planted in the snow at the lake's edge, and his bare ears are red with leaf-shaped white scars, five of them, one for each failure; a thin plume of breath rises; the broken nose has a faint crooked highlight where the light strikes it. Hair: black, short, rough. Body: stocky, square and planted. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, clean, with no sash at all; his white robe has no sash and no collar-band, and the cloth looks fresh and of the better kind, as if someone had insisted on it. Hands and objects: arms crossed over the chest; behind him a reed hut and a line of pale lantern lights show where the test is held. Background: a white frozen lake, the grey horizon. Light: hard light from the upper left. Expression: stubborn, ambitious and brave.

people.imagined: At the vein watch, a blue web of burns climbs her neck; she holds up the right hand with two fingers gone and looks to the sky for thunder.
people.subject: The moment: at the vein watch, a blue web of burns climbs her neck; she raises her right hand, two fingers missing, to shade her eyes against a stormy sky and glances toward the viewer. Face: a calm, lean, weathered face of forty; a faint blue web of lightning-burn scars climbing the right side of her neck to the jaw, plain; steady grey eyes; the blue web of burns is branched like a tree across her neck and the line of her jaw, glowing slightly paler than her skin; her grey eyes squint against the flash and her lips are slightly parted, counting the seconds before thunder. Hair: white-black mix, cropped short. Body: tall, lean and still. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth, high-collared to the jaw, pale-blue sash; copper-wire cuffs; beneath the high collar the web continues into the dark; her robe's copper-wire cuffs gleam faintly. Hands and objects: the right hand with only the thumb, forefinger and middle finger: two fingers gone, plainly shown; the maimed hand is steady, with the stumps of two fingers healed smooth. Background: a stormy sky, copper rods; a tall copper rod behind her has a charred tip; a bank of clouds shows a violet-blue flicker. Light: flat stormlight from the upper left, blue flash at the back. Expression: calm, brave and reclusive.

people.imagined: In the tea kitchen at dawn, he pours first for the person he fancies; his hands are steam-pink and a stained apron shows under the robe.
people.subject: The moment: in the tea kitchen at dawn, he pours first for the person he fancies; his hands are steam-pink and a stained apron shows under the robe; he pours steaming tea from a copper kettle held high and glances sideways at the viewer with a small shrug. Face: a round, mild face of fifty-five with pink cheeks; small content eyes; a snub nose; a wispy grey moustache; a double chin; the apron beneath the white robe is brown with tea stains and has a bright patch; his hands are pink and wrinkled, and a thin sheen of sweat covers his forehead. Hair: grey, thinning, in a small knot. Body: round-shouldered and stout; behind him a row of kettles sits on stone shelves, warmed by stored qi. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a stained apron visible under it; a pale-blue sash. Hands and objects: both hands pink from steam; a copper kettle pouring into a pale cup; a tray of three pale porcelain cups stands in front of him, one set slightly apart, empty for someone who has gone three solstices without a hot cup. Background: a tea kitchen with steam; the copper kettle is dented on one side, and the steam it sheds smells faintly of pine. Light: soft steamy light from the upper left. Expression: arbitrary, humble and content.

people.imagined: On a windy ridge of the head's own peak, herder's beads at the wrist; she will not let the windburn heal and does not smile.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy ridge of the head's own peak, she watches the viewer and does not smile, refusing to turn her face from the wind or let the windburn heal. Face: a strong-boned, weathered face of thirty-three; cheeks raw red with windburn, each patch the shape of a handprint; cool grey eyes narrowed against the gale, tears pulled from the corners; a stern, level mouth; her breath leaves in a short plume and she does not shiver. Hair: black, in one long braid that the wind lifts into a straight line behind her. Body: tall and wiry, planted square on the ridge with her weight low. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash; over it a heavy grey herder's wool cloak, clean and thick, pinned at the shoulder with a bone toggle; sturdy boots. Hands and objects: a string of herder's beads, small knuckle-bones strung on black thread, wound at her wrist; both hands rest on the front of the cloak. Background: a snowy ridge falling away behind her under a white sky, a single lamp-light twinkling far below at the sect seat. Light: cold white light from the upper left, flat and hard, with no warmth in it. Expression: a stern, still, closed look, the mouth a flat line and the eyes steady, a woman who keeps her pain on her face on purpose and will not be pitied.

people.imagined: Last to take off his apron at night, he sits by the furnace at Hàn Giao Chử with the wolves lying round him; the only warm thing they like.
people.subject: The moment: last to take off his apron at night, he sits by the furnace at Hàn Giao Chử with the wolves lying round him, the only warm thing they like; he looks up with an open smile. Face: a ruddy, open young face of thirty; soot on the forehead; warm brown eyes; round cheeks; his big hands are scarred with small burns and his forearms are freckled with soot; the grey wolf at his left leans its head on his thigh with its eyes shut, and another dozes with a paw over its nose; his apron strings are knotted in a double bow, and the last light on his face is red. Hair: short black hair tousled. Body: stocky and sturdy; a spoon and a jar of dark pill-paste sit on a ledge by his knee; a kettle sings on the furnace, and a basket of charcoal stands to the right. Clothing: an alchemist's apprentice's plain brown cloth tunic and a leather apron, still on, sleeves rolled; no white (he is a warm-coloured servant of a cold sect). Hands and objects: a poker in his right hand; a wolf's head under his left hand. Background: a furnace glow, wolves. Light: red furnace glow from the lower left. Expression: diligent, humble and trusting.

people.imagined: At her desk, copying the Snow Plum manual in red ink, a red-stained thumbnail showing, a second sheet hidden beneath her.
people.subject: The moment: at her desk, copying the Snow Plum manual in red ink, a red-stained thumbnail showing, a second sheet hidden beneath her; she holds a red-inked brush over a manual and looks up with a gentle, patient smile. Face: a scholarly, delicate oval face of thirty-eight; calm intelligent dark eyes; a small closed smile; ink-red thumbnail visible; her fingers are slender and long, the thumbnail stained red-brown; a lamp of pale paper throws soft light and her eyes are lowered, then lifted a fraction too late. Hair: black, in a neat low bun with a white pin. Body: slim and composed. Clothing: a white scholar's robe of fine cloth with pale-blue sash; the right cuff stained red; the right cuff of her robe has a long red streak where she has wiped the brush. Hands and objects: a brush dipped in red ink; her right thumbnail a stained red, plain; the red ink in the stone is the colour of dried plum; her desk holds a neat stack of copied leaves, each weighted with a pebble; a second sheet in black ink is half under the blotter, a corner visible. Background: a quiet room, a desk. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: patient, humble and deceitful.

people.imagined: Hauling a pearl diver's net up in a skiff, he coughs like a barking seal and turns his good ear toward the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: hauling a pearl diver's net up into a skiff, he coughs like a barking seal and turns his good ear toward the viewer with a broad, easy grin. Face: a weathered, generous face of thirty-five; kind squinting eyes; a wide grin showing white, uneven teeth; one ear scarred shut by the deep, a puckered knot of scar, the other whole and turned toward us. Hair: black, wet and tied back with a strip of seal-gut cord. Body: broad and barrel-chested, his chest heaving, a bubble of cough rattling in his throat. Clothing: a short white outer robe darkened by wet, with a pale-blue sash, clean and well fitted; a sealskin vest over it; a thin line of dried salt along the collar; sealskin boots. Hands and objects: a wet net hauled over the gunwale with a dozen small white pearls, pea-sized, caught in the mesh; at the bottom of the skiff a puddle and two spare dive-weights of black stone. Background: flat pewter sea and drifting ice, gulls circling, a boy at the oars behind him looking away. Light: cold clear light from the upper left, flat on the water. Expression: an open, generous, good-humoured grin with crinkled eyes, the look of a man who laughs at his own cough and would give a stranger half his catch.

people.imagined: A well-fed clan son at the outer gate, tucking silk laces into his boots before anyone sees; he smiles at a classmate while memorising her method.
people.subject: The moment: a cold morning at the outer gate; a well-fed clan son bends to tuck a bright silk boot-lace out of sight before anyone sees it, and glances up with a friendly smile that comes a little too ready, as he thinks about the pot-reed method he will write home. Face: a plump, smooth, rosy face of eighteen with a soft double chin; sleek confident dark eyes; a small neat smile; clear skin that has never known a hungry winter; a small mole beside the nose. Hair: black, oiled, parted at the side and tied in a neat knot with a dark cord. Body: round-bellied, well fed, bent forward at the waist. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, no sash, new and unwrinkled, a little tight across the middle; under it a clan-silk shirt whose pale cuff shows; good leather boots with silk laces in clan colours, one half-tucked; a small embroidered purse hidden in the sleeve. Hands and objects: the fingers push a silk lace into the boot-top; a folded sheet of notes (no writing visible) pokes from the other sleeve. Background: a pale lake shore with reed huts, a few thin outer disciples sitting on the ice behind. Light: bright cold light from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, deceitful and friendly, a smile for everyone.

people.imagined: Homesick, sitting nearest the brazier in two pairs of mittens, wrists thin as reeds.
people.subject: The moment: seventeen and homesick, she sits nearest the brazier in two pairs of mittens, hugs the small brazier to her knees and looks shyly at the viewer. Face: a small, pale, thin face; huge, trusting dark eyes; a red nose with a drip hanging unnoticed; chapped cheeks; a trembling lower lip held steady; a tiny snowflake of frost on the eyelashes. Hair: light brown, in two short braids tied with string, a woollen cap pulled low. Body: tiny, hunched and wrapped, knees drawn up to the chest. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of plain fine cloth with no sash, too big at the shoulders, clean; over it a thick grey scarf wound three times round her neck; padded leggings; fur-lined boots tied with twine. Hands and objects: two pairs of mittens, one over the other, the outer grey wool and the inner white, both visible; wrists like reeds poking from the cuffs; her fingers curled toward the brazier's heat. Background: the inside of a wooden hut, rough planks, a glowing iron brazier, a steaming kettle, other disciples bundled in the dark behind her. Light: warm brazier glow from below, cold blue light from the door. Expression: wide, wet, hopeful eyes and a lip held tight to keep from trembling, a child being brave about being cold and far from home.

people.imagined: Asleep in the reed hut by the lake after cutting holes, an ice-pick still at his belt, a smell of brine; he opens one eye.
people.subject: The moment: asleep in a reed hut by the lake after cutting ice-fishing holes, an ice-pick still at his belt and the smell of brine on him, he opens one eye, sees the viewer and smiles lazily. Face: a sunburnt, broad, easy face of twenty; sleepy half-open eyes; a wide gap-toothed smile; a fish-scale stuck to one cheek; chapped lips; a stubble of dark whisker. Hair: black, shaggy and sticking up, with a bit of reed in it. Body: stocky and relaxed, sprawled against a bundle of reeds. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of sturdy, clean cloth, stained with brine at the hem, no sash; sealskin boots; a thick scarf. Hands and objects: a short iron ice-pick tucked into his belt, its wooden handle polished pale by his palm; in one hand a string of small silver fish threaded through the gills; a tin cup of cold fish broth by his knee. Background: the reed wall of the hut, bright with sun through its gaps, and behind him through the doorway a frozen lake dotted with fishing holes, a small boy crouched on one with his heels drumming. Light: pale cold light from the upper left, with warm points of sun through the reeds. Expression: drowsy, comfortable and unbothered, one eye half open and a slow grin spreading, a man with no wish to be anywhere else.

people.imagined: Just passed the Frost Test last solstice; her eyes are still red-rimmed and she touches her cheek where she wept, as if checking it.
people.subject: The moment: dawn at the lake, a week after she passed the Frost Test; her eyes are still red-rimmed and she touches two fingers to her cheek where she wept, as if checking it, startled by her own tears, and looks at the viewer with wet eyes. Face: an earnest, soft face of twenty-four; eyes red-rimmed and bright, with a trace of frost at the lashes; a trembling smile; pale cheeks with two faint pink tear-tracks; a straight small nose; a single faint tear-track still shines on her left cheek; behind her on the ice a woman in white, round-faced and kind with reddened earlobes, is seen from the back, wiping her own eyes. Hair: black, in a single plait over the shoulder, a few damp strands on her cheek. Body: slim and upright, standing very straight as the newly chosen do. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth with a new pale-blue sash, perfectly folded and not yet creased; a white collar; new felt boots; her new sash has the shop-crease of folded silk. Hands and objects: two fingers pressed against her cheek; the other hand holds a small warm stone wrapped in cloth. Background: a pale frozen lake at dawn, the thin figure of a round-faced woman in the distance, lantern light. Light: dawn light from the upper left, pink at the horizon. Expression: diligent, humble and moved.

people.imagined: A magistrate's son who looks freshly washed, as if his mother still packed his sleeves; he bows to his master.
people.subject: The moment: a morning at the Pavilion's practice court; a magistrate's son, freshly washed as if his mother still packed his sleeves, bows slightly to his master and looks up politely at the viewer, hands in sleeves. Face: a clean, pleasant, symmetrical face of twenty-five; calm dark eyes; a smooth chin; a faint smile; skin kept soft by good soap; a tiny beauty-mark below one eye. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat topknot with a plain white-jade pin. Body: slender, tidy and well carried. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe, immaculately pressed, with folded sleeves and a pale-blue sash tied in a flat symmetrical knot; white leggings; clean shoes without a mark of mud; a small sachet of dried herbs at the belt; his boots have the clean pale soles of a man who has never run in the mud, and a small tassel of green jade hangs from his sword hilt; a woman in pale robes, his master, stands slightly out of focus at the edge of the frame, turned away, looking at the sky. Hands and objects: both hands tucked into wide sleeves; a plain white sword hangs at his side. Background: a white courtyard with a plain pillar and a bare plum branch. Light: even light from the upper left. Expression: calm, loyal and patient, with the faint ease of one used to being courted.

people.imagined: Coming off the seal beach with seal oil in the creases of her knuckles, barking a laugh, a pup's soft cuff-fur in her pocket.
people.subject: The moment: coming off the seal beach with seal oil in the creases of her knuckles, barking a laugh, a pup's soft cuff-fur in her pocket; she grins and shows the viewer her oil-grey knuckles. Face: a sturdy, freckled, windburnt round face of seventeen; sharp dark eyes; a gap-toothed grin; a flat nose; a fine rime of salt on the brow; her bark of laughter has opened her mouth wide on a missing canine; the apron is stiff with old oil, dark brown and shiny, and has a pocket of grey hide sewn on; her hands are red and chapped, the nails short and black-rimmed, and a thin white scar crosses the back of the left. Hair: black, in a rough knot with a seal-bone pin. Body: short, sturdy, strong arms. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe, the hem greasy with oil, a leather apron over it; sealskin boots; the small bit of white fur in her pocket is the cuff of a seal pup, soft as swansdown. Hands and objects: knuckles shiny with seal oil; a small bit of soft white fur showing from a pocket; a short wooden club at her belt. Background: a grey beach, seals blurred in a long dark row, surf; the seals behind her are dark wet shapes among grey rocks, and a thin line of foam runs up the shingle to her bare toes. Light: cold light from the upper left. Expression: brave, impatient and callous.

people.imagined: Asleep in his leather apron at the forge, forearms soot-black to the elbow; woken by a customer.
people.subject: The moment: asleep in his leather apron at the forge of the Desert Pavilion, forearms soot-black to the elbow; a customer wakes him, and he looks up with a black-streaked face and a wary look. Face: a stubborn, narrow face of twenty-one smeared with soot; suspicious pale eyes; thin lips; a small notch in the left ear; he has dozed in the apron for so long that a crease of leather is pressed into his cheek; a half-forged sword blank glows dull red on the anvil, dropped when he fell asleep, and the water trough beside him has a skin of ash; his thick eyebrows meet in a frown, and the soot-line stops sharply at his elbows where his pale upper arms begin. Hair: black, greasy, in a rough tail. Body: wiry, hunched over the anvil. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe covered by a leather apron, soot at the sleeves; scorched leather cuffs. Hands and objects: both forearms black to the elbow, plain; a short hammer in the right fist; three blades on a rack behind him, none finished; a coin pouch bulges under the apron and a faded receipt string hangs from it. Background: a camel-town forge glow, a sand-coloured wall, a clay water jar; behind him on the wall hang three notched sabres with paid-for tags. Light: red forge-glow from below. Expression: stubborn, greedy and paranoid.

people.imagined: On the lake shore, the third hat lost, a cough hidden behind her hand; she has decided to go to the fishers.
people.subject: The moment: on the lake shore, having lost a third hat to the lake, she coughs politely into her fist and gives the viewer a calm, forgiving smile, having decided to go to the fishers. Face: a thin, pale, sensible face of twenty-eight; tired, kind eyes bright with a little fever; a pink tip of nose; chapped lips; hair-fine lines at the eyes. Hair: brown, tied in a knot with a strip of faded blue cloth in place of the lost hat. Body: slim, wrapped in a wool shawl, her shoulders drawn in against the cold. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth with a grey wool shawl over it; wool leggings; sturdy shoes; at her feet a small bundle tied with cord holds a spare tunic and a cooking pot. Hands and objects: one fist raised to her mouth; the cord-tied bundle at her feet. Background: a frozen lake and a line of pale lanterns along the ice where the test is being sat, one thin figure in white walking away from it, snow dusting her shawl. Light: flat grey light from the upper left. Expression: a small, tired, gentle smile and a slight shrug, as if saying there is no shame in leaving, the look of someone who has weighed it and is at peace.

people.imagined: In the sword hall, cropped head, wrist wrapped in a hand's width of cloth; glaring across the hall at a rival.
people.subject: The moment: in the sword hall, a raid orphan with a cropped head and a wrist wrapped in a hand's width of cloth, glaring across the hall at his master's rival; he glares with his wrapped wrist raised on a sword hilt. Face: a hard young face of twenty-six, cropped scalp showing, scarred brow; hot dark eyes; a snarling mouth; a fresh bruise at the jaw; his cropped head shows a long old scar over one ear; across the hall a young woman in white with a sharp-featured face stands with her arms folded, small and out of focus; sweat darkens the back of his robe, and the muscles of his jaw stand out as he grinds his teeth. Hair: cropped to the scalp. Body: compact and tense. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth, narrow sleeves, a pale-blue sash; leggings; plain shoes; the cloth on his wrist is a soiled grey, tied in a hard knot, with a rusty stain showing at the edge. Hands and objects: his right wrist wrapped in a wide band of cloth a hand's width, grey with sweat; the hand grips a white-hilted sword. Background: a sword hall with a polished floor and a distant white-robed figure; the practice hall's floor reflects his figure. Light: light from the upper left. Expression: diligent, loyal and wrathful.

people.imagined: On the lake ice, writing a bird poem with a quill behind her ear; ink on her chin.
people.subject: The moment: on the lake ice, writing a bird poem on a small book with a quill behind her ear and ink on her chin; she sits on the ice and looks up with a lazy happy smile. Face: a round, rosy face of nineteen with ink on the chin, plain; dreamy green-brown eyes; a wide smile; a dimple. Hair: brown, loose with a quill stuck behind the ear. Body: soft, comfortable and cross-legged. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of plain fine cloth, with slips of paper poking out of every pocket; a green scarf; fur-lined boots; her boots are lined with yellow fur and one lace is untied. Hands and objects: a quill; a small book; ink has dripped from the quill onto the ice in a small black star; a small stone ink-slab sits beside her knee, and a smear of ink dyes the heel of her hand; behind her a tidy herb bed lies under snow, and a thin quiet girl with dirt under her nails weeds it with a trowel. Background: a frozen lake, birds far off; the poem on her page is a set of small lines with a drawing of an oriole in the corner (no readable words). Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: gregarious, content and dreamy.

people.imagined: Breathing the primer so slowly that his scarf hardly moves; eyes shut.
people.subject: The moment: sixteen, in the reed marsh breathing the primer so slowly that his scarf hardly moves; he sits cross-legged with his eyes closed, one eye cracking to see the viewer. Face: a thin, serene boy's face; closed lids; a small calm mouth; a faint down on the lip; skin pale with cold; his scarf lies across his chest, perfectly flat; the single open eye is pale brown and calm; behind him the marsh reeds stand frosted and still, and a round-faced woman in white watches from a distance, nodding to herself; a small thread of breath rises from his nose, slow and thin; his lips are slightly parted and a thin breath-thread rises. Hair: black, in a short tail. Body: thin, folded and still. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe with a plain grey scarf that does not move; thin cotton leggings; straw shoes; his sandals are set side by side on the ice, neatly, as though he had been told to. Hands and objects: hands on knees, palms up. Background: a reed marsh and pale sky, a distant hut; a small icicle hangs from a reed above his head and does not drip. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: cautious, humble and patient.

people.imagined: Selling a bit of gossip for a dried plum, her quick brown eyes never settling.
people.subject: The moment: in a corridor, she sells a bit of gossip for a dried plum, offering one from a pouch and looking sideways at the viewer, her quick eyes never settling. Face: a sharp, quick, small face of twenty; restless brown eyes that dart left and right, checking the corridor behind the viewer; a cheerful, honest-seeming smile; a small mole at the corner of the mouth. Hair: brown, in a messy plait. Body: small and nimble, weight on the balls of her feet as if ready to slip away. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth with the sleeve rolled once, a smudge of plum sugar on the cuff; neat leggings; a pouch of faded blue cloth with a drawstring swelling at her waist. Hands and objects: the plum, wrinkled, dark red and sugared, held out by the stem between finger and thumb; the other hand on the plump pouch. Background: a pale-painted corridor wall with a narrow window showing grey snow, a pair of white-robed disciples blurred in deep conversation at its end. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: a bright, easy, over-friendly smile with eyes that do not stay on you, the face of a quick girl who is pleasant to everyone and weighs what each is worth.

people.imagined: Wringing out her heavy wet hair before entering a room, a waterfall-village girl.
people.subject: The moment: before entering a room, a waterfall-village girl wrings out her heavy wet hair, twisting a rope of black hair in both fists so that a stream of water falls, and looks up boldly at the viewer. Face: a bright, fierce face of eighteen; clear brave eyes; wet lashes beaded with spray; a determined mouth; droplets on the pale fuzz of her upper lip; a single drop falling from her chin. Hair: very long black hair, soaking, twisted in her fists, so heavy it drags her head back a little. Body: strong and sturdy, planted in the doorway with feet apart; behind her a waterfall glints through an open door, white and loud, and she grins as though about to run back into it. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, the shoulders soaked dark, the sleeves rolled to the elbow showing strong brown forearms; bare feet, wet. Hands and objects: both hands wringing the rope of wet hair, the water falling in a bright rope to a puddle on the stone threshold and splashing her bare toes. Background: a stone threshold with a wet footprint, the white blur of the waterfall through the door. Light: bright light from the upper left, with the spray glittering. Expression: a bold, challenging, half-laughing look, chin up, as if daring anyone to mind the water on the floor.

people.imagined: Smiling sincerely at the teacher about the test, tar under his nails and a rope burn across his palm.
people.subject: The moment: smiling sincerely at the teacher about the test, with tar under his nails and a rope burn across his palm; he smiles earnestly with both hands held open in front of him. Face: an honest-looking, calm, regular face of twenty-two; pleasant eyes; a practised smile; he smiles with his whole face, creasing both cheeks, and his eyes are friendly, but his open palms are held a little too still; his scarf is tied in a sailor's flat knot, and a good spot on the ice, marked with a small flag, lies in the middle distance. Hair: black, neat. Body: medium and easy. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe, a plain scarf; his sleeves are rolled a precise fold, and one boot toe points toward the sea. Hands and objects: tar under every nail; a red rope-burn across the right palm, plain; the tar under his nails is black, the rope-burn is a long red welt that has blistered at one edge. Background: a lake edge and a boat; behind him a small boat is drawn up on the shingle with a family's mark painted on the bow, a simple blue fish. Light: light from the upper left. Expression: calm, pragmatic and deceitful.

people.imagined: A clerk's daughter at the Desert Pavilion; practice characters inked in rows down her cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: a clerk's daughter at the Desert Pavilion; practice characters inked in rows down her cuffs; she holds out one cuff to the viewer with a diligent smile. Face: a neat, patient face of twenty-eight; clever dark eyes; a small smile; the rows on her cuff are of small neat dark strokes, drill after drill, filling the whole inner face of the sleeve, repeated and crossed out; the sun is bright, her skin lightly tanned, and her cheeks round and calm. Hair: black, in a neat bun; a white clay inkpot is tucked in her sash and a ribbon bookmark hangs from her pocket. Body: slim and tidy; the courtyard behind her is pale sand with a low wall, a camel's knee at the frame's edge, and a veiled woman with a gold nostril stud is a pace away speaking to her. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe, a pale-blue sash; the cuffs covered in rows of small black practice strokes (no readable letters); a small brush hangs from her sash. Hands and objects: one cuff held up; her fingers show ink on the right forefinger. Background: a sandy courtyard. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: patient, loyal and humble.

people.imagined: Rolling like a caravan guard as he walks, one eyebrow split in two; he thinks the Frost Test a waste of a winter.
people.subject: The moment: in a caravan yard he walks toward the viewer with a rolling swagger and a grin, one thumb hooked in his belt, as though the Frost Test were a waste of a winter. Face: a broad, tanned, cheerful face of twenty-five; bold eyes; a scar splitting the left eyebrow in two, each half at a different height so he looks permanently quizzical; a wide grin showing a chipped front tooth. Hair: black, cropped short, the bare head catching the hard sun. Body: broad and bandy-legged, a caravan guard's roll in his stance. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth cut short at the thigh for riding, over thick leggings, sleeves folded to the elbow to show wide forearms tanned dark and sprinkled with sand; leather arm-guards; boots scuffed pale with dust. Hands and objects: a thumb hooked in a worn leather belt strap; a sword hanging low at his hip, its hilt wrapped in grubby white cloth. Background: a caravan yard, a line of kneeling camels chewing, a water-skin hanging from a wagon, an older guard in a pale-blue sash watching him walk. Light: bright hard sun from the upper left. Expression: a swaggering, cocky grin with the quizzical eyebrow raised, easy and loud and sure of himself.

people.imagined: Digging in the ice-herb bed, a seed in every pocket, dirt under her nails.

people.imagined: Fur-pattern freckles; asleep in her boots against a sable's den; just woken.

people.imagined: Sweeping the Vessel Hall; a white streak at the temple; a broom-callused palm.

people.imagined: Proud of his first moustache shadow, ears sunburnt, looking at his cousin as if at the best man alive.

people.imagined: Midnight on the mere, walking the line with warm stones, the roll under one arm like a child.

people.imagined: On the skiff, a whistle every harbour knows; burn-spotted lamp-maker's fingers.

Face: a lean, jolly face; pitted burns on fingers; bright eyes; he puts two burn-spotted fingers to his lips and whistles the tune that every harbour knows; his lean cheeks are puffed, eyes bright; the white robe has a coast-blue lining flashing at the cuff, and the pale-blue sash is tied loose; his fingers are speckled with tiny pale burn scars from lamp-making, big and plain; behind him on the harbour a skiff rocks with its brown sail furled, a lantern on a pole at the dock, and two skiff-men sit apart from him on a net-pile with their backs turned; his mouth under the whistle is a little greedy. people.imagined: Clicking the beads of an abacus in her sleeve, squinting at anything not set in columns.
people.subject: The moment: she squints hard at the viewer as at an unbalanced sum, her small abacus clicking in one hand with the beads pushed to the left, squinting at anything not set in columns. Face: a plain, shrewd face of thirty-eight; narrowed eyes suspicious of someone else's sums; a straight nose; a firm mouth; fine lines between the brows. Hair: black, drawn into a plain bun held by a wooden pin, not a strand out of place. people.imagined: On the ice off his village, his grandfather's wool cap; a three-fingered mitten on his left hand.
people.subject: The moment: he sits beside a fishing hole in the ice wearing his grandfather's brown wool cap and a three-fingered mitten, calm and unbothered by the skiff and the tall broad man with a scarred chin who wave an invitation behind him that he is ignoring. Face: a round, calm, weathered, friendly face of thirty-two; small blue eyes; a snub nose; a wide peaceful mouth, grey-stubbled, with a small unlit clay pipe set in one corner. Hair: black, showing at the edges of the cap. Body: stocky and still, settled onto the ice like a stone. people.imagined: Salt-streaked braids, a shout held behind her teeth, at the Pavilion's council door.

Face: a strong, flushed, angry face; flashing dark eyes; clenched teeth; she stands rigid in a doorway, jaw clenched, a shout held behind her teeth, one fist half-raised and trembling; her strong flushed face has flashing dark eyes, broad cheekbones and an angry full mouth; behind her a hall door opens onto a council room with elders in frost-silk sashes sitting in a row, and a cold-faced man at the lake's primer stands at the edge; light from the upper left is hard and white on her angry face. Hair: black braids streaked white with salt; her salt-streaked braids are thick as rope and hang to her waist, black with white lines where the sea has dried in them; the veins stand out at her wrist, and a single strand of black hair is stuck in the salt at her temple. people.imagined: Weighing a coin on her palm; greened fingertips from ledger powder.
people.subject: The moment: in the caravan office she holds a coin up on her flat palm and bites her lower lip, weighing it, then glances over it at the viewer. Face: a shrewd, merry face of forty; quick dark eyes; round cheeks; a wide mouth caught between a grin and a calculation; the fingertips lifted near her face are tinted pale green from ledger powder. Hair: black, in a neat bun fixed with a bone pin. Body: stout and brisk, weight forward as if about to bargain. Expression: a bright, shrewd, good-humoured look, the lip caught in her teeth and the eyes already guessing the weight, a woman who likes everyone and still counts the change.

people.imagined: His gaze always on the horizon, lips sun-split, a hundred and nine crossings behind him.

Face: a lean, sun-burnt, long face of forty-four; far-looking pale eyes narrowed in focus; sun-split lips; a hawk nose; grey-flecked stubble; lines at the eyes deep as cracks in a dry riverbed. Hair: black, hidden under a white headcloth wound round head and neck against the sand, its tail whipping in the wind. Body: lean and dry as a rope, standing loose and easy as one who walks all day. Clothing: a white desert robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash, clean at the shoulder though dusty below; the white headcloth; one hand gloved in leather against the rein. Hands and objects: both hands on the rein of the tall tawny camel at his shoulder, the gloved one closed round it, the other bare and brown. Expression: a still, distant, patient gaze, the brows drawn slightly together against the glare, a man more at home with a far line than with any face near him.

people.imagined: Drawing the founder's well at dawn; well-rope calluses; scribe's sleeves pinned.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she draws water from the founder's well, pulling the rope hand over hand, and looks up serenely at the viewer. Hands and objects: both palms ridged with calluses from the well-rope, gripping the taut rope; the bucket rising out of sight below. Background: the dark, damp stone well-head with a thin skin of ice, and behind it a sand dune glowing pale gold as the sun's first edge touches it; to one side a woman with a dried lily bulb in her braid scatters grain for a pair of sparrows. Expression: a serene, patient, inward look, the eyes lifted and the mouth at rest, a woman for whom a morning chore is a kind of prayer.

people.imagined: A camel-driver's bow-legged stance, an upper tooth missing, training the guard's sons.
people.subject: The moment: in the guard's training yard he stands bow-legged and grins at the viewer to show a missing upper tooth, correcting a young boy's grip on a wooden practice sword. Background: a sandy training yard marked with a ring of stones and a row of wooden posts, a few young guards in white practising cuts, a camel tethered at a rail. Light: bright dry light from the upper left. people.imagined: Chisel behind his ear, grit in every knuckle crease, one empty niche kept for himself.
people.subject: The moment: he looks calmly at the viewer, a chisel behind his ear. Face: a calm, craggy face; ice dust on the brows; his craggy calm face has ice dust whitening the brows and lashes, deep-set eyes, a big nose, and a few days of grey stubble; the white robe is dusty at the hem, with a pale-blue sash, and he wears a leather apron slashed with pale scratches. Hands and objects: gritty knuckles; a mallet; he stands before a half-cut niche, a short iron chisel tucked behind his ear and a wooden mallet hanging in one hand; his hands are broad, every knuckle crease gritty with ice dust; the mallet's head is dark with years of use and has a worn hollow where his palm fits. people.imagined: Tilting her head to the west when thunder is near on the vein watch.
people.subject: The moment: she tilts her head toward the left, listening, then glances at the viewer. Face: a narrow, alert face; listening eyes; she tilts her head to the left, eyes half closed, listening, one hand raised to her ear; her narrow alert face has a long nose, dark attentive eyes and a thin mouth slightly open; behind her a stormy ridge shows tall copper rods against a purple-grey sky and a distant flash of blue lightning, with a line of small lights marking the vein watch; a thin silver chain at her neck carries a small copper whistle, and a faint pale freckle pattern dusts her nose. Clothing: a white robe with copper-wire cuffs, a pale-blue sash; her white robe has copper-wire wound round the cuffs and a pale-blue sash, and a leather strap across her chest holds a small notebook. Hands and objects: hand lifted to her ear. Background: a stormy ridge; her figure is thin and tense. Light: light from the upper left; the light is flat and cold from the upper left, and she counts the seconds silently. Expression: cautious, loyal, diligent.

people.imagined: Turning his clan seal ring when slighted; boots too fine for the hall.
people.subject: The moment: slighted in the sword hall, he turns his heavy clan seal ring round and round on his finger with his thumb and looks down his nose at the viewer. Face: a handsome, haughty face of forty-five with a lean, pale, well-kept complexion; a thin moustache; a high-bridged nose; cold eyes; a small tight mouth. Hair: black, oiled and combed back from the forehead, bound up high with a jewelled pin. Body: tall and straight, chin lifted, one shoulder turned slightly away, the posture lofty and wounded. Hands and objects: a heavy seal ring turned with the thumb; a white-hilted sword hanging at the hip in a scabbard of pale lacquer; the other hand held stiffly at his side. Background: a sword hall of pale boards, where a white-robed woman with a sharp-featured face practises alone at the far end. Light: cool, bright light from the upper left, making the white cloth glare. people.imagined: Up from the tunnels with damp knees, a lamp that smells of oil, writing 'warm' again.
people.subject: The moment: up from the tunnels with damp knees and a lamp that smells of oil, he stands at the tunnel mouth and looks at the viewer with a troubled frown, about to report the tunnels warm again. Hair: grey-brown, tied back in a short knot with a few loose strands stuck to his damp forehead. Expression: a worried, conscientious look, the brows knit and the mouth downturned, an honest man who dreads the one word he must report and will report it anyway.

people.imagined: A sable's tail stitched to her cap, hoarding hay in a rented loft.
people.subject: The moment: in a rented stable loft she tips her fur cap with a sable's tail stitched to the back and grins at the viewer, a handful of golden hay sifting through her fist. people.imagined: Singing a coast song; a fishing-line scar round one wrist.
people.subject: The moment: singing a coast song with his mouth wide open, he holds out his wrist toward the viewer to show a thin pale scar like a bracelet, left by a fishing line that once snared him. Face: a lean, bright, boyish face of twenty; fair brows; quick eyes; a sunburnt nose; the mouth open in song, the chin lifted. Hair: black, cropped short and stiff with salt. Body: wiry, with thin tanned arms and a narrow chest, leaning forward eagerly onto the balls of his feet, one shoulder lifted with the effort of the song. Hands and objects: the wrist held out, ringed by the thin scar; at his feet on the ice a coil of fishing line and a bone hook. Background: the lake glittering behind him, and on the shore a woman holding a shout back behind her teeth.
