Expression: an eager, open-mouthed, impatient grin, the eyebrows lifted and the eyes darting to see who is listening, a boy bursting to be noticed.

people.imagined: Powder-white face, clan gloves too small for her big hands, on the eve of the test.
people.subject: The moment: on the eve of her first test she stands before a pillar in the Pavilion's outer court and holds up both hands in tight gloves, looking serenely at the viewer. Face: a long, plain face of twenty-two powdered chalk-white so that the features look carved; calm, clever dark eyes under level brows; a long straight nose; a composed mouth painted a faint rose. Hair: black, drawn up in the clan's high knot with two jade pins. Body: tall and straight, shoulders level, perfectly composed. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of very fine silk-cotton with a narrow pale-grey edging and a clan pattern woven into the cloth. Hands and objects: both hands raised in tight gloves of fine white kid a size too small, the wrists showing red between glove and cuff. Background: the outer court of the Pavilion; at the gate her brothers and servants of the Tiêu clan wait with a lacquered box, and a plump boy in silk-laced boots looks away. Light: bright, cool light from the upper left. Expression: a calm, level, appraising look with a faint, practised smile, the eyes steady and clever, a clan daughter who has decided in advance how the test will go.

people.imagined: Snow melting in his hair, going blank mid-sentence.
people.subject: The moment: at night he sits in a snowdrift with snow melting in his hair and the pale eyes gone blank in the middle of a sentence, as though the voice had been blown out of him, and looks at the viewer. Face: a thin, pale, patient face of twenty-four; the lips blue; the pale eyes blank and unfocused. Hair: black, plastered flat with snowmelt, drops glittering in it. Body: thin, sitting small in the snow with his back unwrapped. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth stiff with frost at the shoulders, belted with a plain cord; a few small paper talismans, blank, tucked into the sleeve. Hands and objects: both hands resting open on his knees, bluish and cracked with cold. Background: the lake lying under stars with lantern points along it, and beside him a woman with her breath smoking, a roll under her arm and a warm stone in her hand, stepping toward him to bring him in. Light: cold blue starlight from the upper left, with a small warm glow from the lanterns. Expression: a blank, patient, hollow gaze, the mouth a little open and the brows slack, the look of a diligent man who has worked past the end of himself and has not noticed.

people.imagined: Fingers crossed behind her back, net-mender's calluses, tripping on dry ground.
people.subject: The moment: on the eve of her third and last Frost Test she stands at the edge of the lake with her fingers crossed behind her back and gives the viewer a steady look; she has just tripped on dry ground and is righting herself, one foot slightly sideways. Face: a calm, plain, stubborn face of twenty-five; grey-brown eyes; a net-mender's wide mouth set firm; her breath leaves in a short plume. Hair: brown, in a thick plait pinned up. Body: sturdy and square, one foot turned awkwardly to catch her balance. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe, clean and neat, a thin pale-blue sash; plain wool leggings and sturdy shoes. Hands and objects: both hands behind her back with the fingers crossed, the palms and fingers crossed with net-mender's calluses where they show at the side. Background: the grey lake with a thin gold thread of sunrise lying along it, and on a bench behind her a white-haired woman with a small bundle and a cough hidden behind her hand, watching and saying goodbye. Light: flat, pale light from the upper left. Expression: a steady, honest, dogged look, the jaw set and the eyes unflinching, a plain woman who has decided she will not look away from this.

people.imagined: Asleep in the hay in the sable shed with a wide sleepy grin.
people.subject: The moment: seventeen, he lies full length in a heap of yellow hay in the sable shed and grins sleepily, an empty wooden bucket on its side beside him. Face: a wide, sleepy, freckled face; drooping eyelids with a few strands of hay caught in the lashes; a wide, slow grin. Hair: brown and tousled, with hay in it like a nest and a stray strand across his freckled forehead. Body: gangly, long limbs sprawled, one bare foot sticking out of the hay with a grey sock half off; a small white sable kit curled asleep on his chest. Clothing: a rumpled white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth with straw clinging to the sleeves and the collar half open. Hands and objects: an empty bucket beside him; one hand loose over the kit. Background: pens of straw and rows of other empty buckets showing a feeding turn missed, and a sturdy girl with seal oil on her knuckles standing in the doorway with a strap in her hand, sighing. Light: warm, dusty, golden light, as through the slats of the shed wall, from the upper left, motes in the beam. Expression: a wide, drowsy, unashamed grin, eyes half shut, a boy who has forgotten the whole world and is perfectly happy to be found.

people.imagined: Fine pale hair standing up in fear as she looks at the lake.
people.subject: The moment: she stands at the edge of the lake looking at it with terror, her fine pale hair lifted by fear, and then turns to the viewer; she has only a thread of Ice in her root and is more afraid than anyone who has none. Face: a pale, frightened, delicate face of nineteen; wide light eyes; a small mouth pressed tight; a faint blue vein at the temple; her breath comes in short white puffs. Hair: fine, pale and standing straight up from her scalp like thistledown. Body: small and slight, the shoulders shaking a little, the arms rigid. Clothing: a clean white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth a little large for her, belted with a plain cord. Hands and objects: both hands clenched at her sides. Background: the lake a flat white plate under a grey sky with lantern points across it, the first snow falling; at a distance her teacher, a sharp-faced man with a carrying voice, stands with arms folded. Light: cold, flat light from the upper left. Expression: wide, frightened eyes and a mouth pressed tight to hold the trembling in, the face of a careful girl who is afraid and is going to go in anyway.

people.imagined: Sitting on a fishing hole as if on a stool, heels drumming.
people.subject: The moment: he sits on a round fishing hole cut in the lake ice as if it were a stool, heels drumming against the edge, and waves cheerfully at the viewer. Face: a cheeky, round, sunburnt face of seventeen; bright black eyes; a snub nose; a missing front milk-tooth in a wide grin. Hair: black, messy and sticking up. Body: small, thin-wristed and restless, bouncing on the spot, shoulders hunched up against the cold and the whole frame full of unspent energy. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth in a boy's size, clean, with a knitted grey scarf wound twice round the neck; boots too big for him and stuffed with straw. Hands and objects: one hand waving; a tiny fish-hook on a line lying in his lap. Background: the frozen lake stretching white with other holes, a thin crust of ice forming at the rim of his own, and a stocky older brother asleep in a reed hut behind. Light: bright, cold light from the upper left, glaring off the white ice and making him squint. Expression: a cheerful, gap-toothed, cheeky grin, bright-eyed and unembarrassed, a boy who talks to everyone and is not afraid of any of them.

people.imagined: Carrying a tray of qi-warmed tea carefully down to the lake.
people.subject: The moment: at the start of a night of the Frost Test she carries a steaming tray of qi-warmed tea down a lakeside path with her eyes on every cup, and then glances up with a small calm smile at the viewer. Face: a careful, content, round face of eighteen; soft brown eyes; a rounded chin; fine fair brows; a faint flush from the steam. Hair: black, in a neat bun. Body: small and slight, stepping with the short careful steps of someone entrusted with a single precious thing. Clothing: a clean white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, a little too long, with the sleeves tied back by a cord and a pale grey apron over it. Hands and objects: a lacquer tray of six small cups, each one steaming, held level in both hands. Background: the lakeside path lined with small pale lanterns, a row of huddled figures out on the lake, and her round-shouldered great-uncle waving a kettle in the distance. Light: soft golden light rising from the cups and cool light from above and the upper left. Expression: a gentle, composed, contented half-smile and a steady gaze, the look of a girl who is quietly pleased to be trusted with something warm and means to deliver it without a spill.

people.imagined: Drawing patterns in the snow, fingers chalk-white.
people.subject: The moment: she kneels in the snow drawing a pattern with one chalk-white finger, tongue between her teeth, then looks up eagerly at the viewer. Face: an eager, round face of twenty-one flushed pink with cold; bright brown eyes; short brows; a wide, quick smile and a nose pink from the cold. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a white cloth. Body: slim and light, kneeling and leaning over her drawing with her tongue caught between her teeth and her ponytail swinging forward over one shoulder. Clothing: a clean white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, the knees dark with melted snow. Hands and objects: the fingers chalk-white to the second knuckle, a stub of white chalk clutched in the left hand; on the snow a ring of small interlocking circles and spokes, a formation diagram, and beside it a second smaller pattern half rubbed out by her sleeve, showing she has tried it twice. Background: open snow, a thin mist rising from the waterfall-village girl's spot behind her, and under an arch a stooped uncle with damp knees and a lamp. Light: bright soft light from the upper left on the snow. Expression: a bright, trusting, open-faced eagerness, the eyes wide and the smile ready, a girl certain that this time it will work.

people.imagined: The unpaid elder brother of the outer gate, one shoulder worn down by others' bags, stopping mid-word.
people.subject: The moment: he stops mid-word and stands blank until the viewer says his name, one shoulder lowered by years of carrying other people's bags; he is the outer gate's unpaid elder brother, who failed three Frost Tests at twenty-six and stayed. Face: a mild, kind, tired face of thirty-two; soft grey eyes; laugh lines; a stubbled jaw; a long forgiving nose. Hair: black, tied in a plain knot with a few early grey hairs. Body: one shoulder lower than the other, standing a little crooked and easy. Clothing: a clean white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, neatly mended at the elbow and cuff in the careful way of a man who has no one to do it for him, with someone's satchel strap still looped over the lowered shoulder. Hands and objects: a stranger's bag on the lower shoulder and another bag in his hand. Background: the frozen lake behind him and a line of younger disciples sitting on the ice in rows, one of them a scarred man with a crooked nose who looks away. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. Expression: a mild, patient, faintly puzzled look, the mouth a little open on the lost word and the eyes kind, a man who has made his peace with being the one who carries.

people.imagined: A grave-cutter's squint; he knows where he'll be buried.
people.subject: The moment: he stands before a niche cut in the burial glacier and squints calmly at the viewer, the grave-cutter's squint exactly like his father's, calm in the knowledge of exactly where he will be buried. Face: a calm, squinting face of nineteen; a straight nose; thick black brows white at the tips with ice dust; a stubborn jaw; a mouth that gives nothing away; a faint rim of ice dust on the lower lashes. Hair: black, cut short. Body: sturdy and broad, planted square and still. Clothing: a clean white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, the shoulders clean and the hem dusted white. Hands and objects: big hands holding a small hammer loosely at his side; at the wall behind him a lamp casting blue light on the ice. Background: the blue niche, a clear arch with a smooth interior, in the glacier wall; standing figures in ice receding beside him, and a little way off his father with a chisel behind his ear, his scarred chisel hand a blur at the edge of the frame. Light: cold blue light from the lamp and the ice, with a pale light from the upper left. Expression: a still, level, honest squint, the jaw set and the mouth shut, a young man who is stubbornly at peace with it.

people.imagined: Reading ice from a skiff by its colour; palms blistered at the bow oar.
people.subject: The moment: she sits at the bow of a skiff reading the ice by its colour, her grey eyes gone pale as slate, then looks at the viewer. Face: a hard, lean, pale-eyed face of twenty-six; a thin straight nose; a thin mouth; wind-chapped cheeks; salt drying in pale lines along the jaw. Hair: black, cut short and wet at the ends. Body: wiry, sitting braced at the bow with her weight forward. Clothing: a short white skiff-hand's robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash, stiff with salt; sturdy boots. Hands and objects: both palms open on her knees, blistered at the heel from the bow oar, some of the blisters broken and weeping; a coil of wet rope and a boat-hook at her feet and the oar lying across the thwart. Background: the sea a plain of grey floes, a cracked floe and a net-boat far off, and a stocky captain with a salt-white scar standing at the tiller. Light: cold, flat light from the upper left. Expression: a hard, narrowed, impatient look, the pale eyes fixed on the colour of the floe and the lips thin, a woman who has stared at the same cold sea too long and will go out on it again.

people.imagined: Hair that never dries; a pearl-seller's smile; a pearl in his cheek.
people.subject: The moment: he grins at the viewer with one cheek slightly bulging, a pearl-seller's smile, a pearl hidden in his cheek, hands held open and empty to show nothing. Face: a wide-mouthed, damp, grinning face of twenty-three; bright, shrewd eyes crinkled with the grin; one cheek puffed where the pearl hides; a trace of nacre gleaming at the corner of his mouth. Hair: black and always wet, plastered to his forehead and dripping at the ends, drops falling steadily onto his collar. Body: broad and strong in the chest, a diver's build. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, dark with water, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, over a sealskin vest; a net bag at the belt holding a few ordinary grey shells. Hands and objects: both hands held open and empty in front of him, palms up, to show he has nothing. Background: a skin-boat of stitched hides bobbing near the shore, and a deaf-eared diver beside it who coughs and looks away as the count of the share comes out short; the sea grey behind. Light: pale cold light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, innocent, wickedly pleased grin, the eyes crinkled and the cheek bulging, a lad who is delighted by his own cleverness and quite sure no one will check.

people.imagined: Covering the page with her sleeve as she writes.
people.subject: The moment: she shields a page with her sleeve as she writes and looks up warily at the viewer. Face: a pale, cautious face of twenty-eight; quick dark eyes; a straight narrow nose; a thin mouth. Hair: black, drawn into a neat bun pinned with a plain wooden pin, every strand smoothed back. Body: slim and narrow-shouldered, the shoulders curved over the desk as if to hide it, her whole body turned a little away from the door. Clothing: a clean white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash, the left sleeve held across the page like a screen. Hands and objects: the sleeve laid across the page; her slender right hand holding a fine brush with the tip dark with ink; on the desk two sheets, one longer, with a line trimmed neatly from its edge by a small knife that rests beside it. Background: the copy room with shelves of tied rolls, a stool, a lamp, and a tall quiet woman with abacus beads in her sleeve passing the door. Light: soft lamp glow from the upper left. Expression: a wary, guarded glance, the eyes lifted sideways over the sleeve and the lips pressed thin, a careful woman who is working on something she does not want seen.

people.imagined: Knuckles still swollen from the fist that cost him the seat.
people.subject: The moment: knuckles still swollen from the fist that cost him his seat, he holds the bruised right hand up to the viewer, jaw set in anger, a bundle tied in cloth gripped in his left. Face: a square, young face of twenty-seven; brown, angry eyes; thick brows; a short nose; a split lip healing. Hair: black, short and rough. Body: broad with a fighter's thick neck, shoulders squared, weight forward. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth pulled askew at one shoulder seam and a pale-blue sash hanging loose, a sign of a hearing he did not wait for. Hands and objects: the right hand held up, the knuckles skinned raw, red and purple and shiny, with a dark crust at the first joint and a fresh yellow-green bruise spreading up the forearm; the left hand gripping the cloth bundle. Background: a grey harbour town with boats and a quay, a skiff with a coast-blue lantern, and a coast disciple with a drawl pulling at his arm. Light: flat grey light from the upper left. Expression: a hot, scowling, defiant glare, the jaw clenched and the brows lowered, a loyal man who still believes the blow was right.

people.imagined: Asleep on the bailing bucket, forearms like buckets.
people.subject: The moment: he dozes on an upturned bailing bucket in a skiff and wakes to see the viewer, the huge forearms folded on his knees. Face: a round, trusting, sleepy face of nineteen; a snub nose; small bright eyes just opening; a drool-line at the corner of the mouth; a single silver scale shining on one cheek. Hair: black and messy, flattened on one side from the bucket's rim where he slept. Body: huge-forearmed and thick-set, slumped comfortably on the bucket. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth, stained fishy at the front, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder. Hands and objects: the thick brown forearms folded on his knees, speckled with fish scales, a bailing bucket's rim leaving a red ring on one; beside him a basket of silver fish lying in the sun with gulls eyeing it. Background: the skiff's brown sail flapping, and on the dock his lean uncle with a whistle at his lips. Light: bright, warm light from the upper left, glittering on the water and gleaming on the fish scales. Expression: a slow, blinking, good-natured look just waking, the mouth a little open and the eyes soft, a trusting lad who expects the world to be kind and to bring him lunch.

people.imagined: Salt-white lashes, a laugh that comes out as a cough; never seen ice outside a cup.
people.subject: The moment: she laughs and coughs at once, holding a cup in which a single piece of ice floats, and looks happily at the viewer; it is the first ice she has ever seen outside a cup. Face: a round, merry face of twenty-one; salt-white lashes catching the sun like frost and making her eyes look pale; short dark brows; a wide, generous mouth; pink cheeks. Hair: black, in a thick plait under a sand-coloured scarf. Body: sturdy and sun-brown, broad in the hip and shoulder, the whole frame shaking with the laugh and the cough, her head tipped back. Clothing: a clean white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth with a thin desert veil at the neck; sandals with a rim of white salt crusted on them. Hands and objects: a cup of water held in both hands with one piece of ice floating in it, already melting and sparkling. Background: a sandy yard with a well, her salt-pan cousin's saddle a dark shape behind her, a camel peering over a wall. Light: bright, dry desert light from the upper left, sparkling in the ice and on the white lashes. Expression: an open, delighted, breathless laugh with wide eyes fixed on the ice, honest to the point of rudeness and quick to give the cup to anyone who asks.

people.imagined: Rolling a coin over his knuckles in a tavern, mouth twisted bitter.
people.subject: The moment: in a tavern he rolls a coin across his knuckles and smirks bitterly at the viewer, having left the sect's whites behind. Face: a thin, sour, handsome face of twenty-three; narrow dark eyes; a straight nose; a mouth twisted to one side, with a faint line from nose to lip that deepens when he smirks. Hair: black, oiled and combed straight back from a high forehead, one lock fallen loose over the left eyebrow. Body: lean and long-limbed, slouched sideways in a rough wooden chair with one elbow on the table and one boot hooked on a rung, loose and deliberately careless. Clothing: a plain oasis tunic of good brown cloth, wide-sleeved, belted with a sash of dyed red wool, in place of the sect's white robe. Hands and objects: a bright copper coin walking over each knuckle in turn; a small clay cup of cheap wine at his other hand, barely touched; the sash's red wool bright against the brown cloth. Background: a tavern of the oasis town of Hồi Lan with low lamps, rugs and men in headcloths listening to him. Light: warm low lamplight from the upper left, with the coin glinting. Expression: a bitter, one-sided smirk, the eyes narrow and the brow arrogant, a man who nurses an old grievance patiently and enjoys the taste of it.

people.imagined: Inside her sealed cave on Băng Bích Nhai, 190 years into watching. She has just heard a step in the snow outside and turned only her head; her hair, never cut in two hundred years, is wrapped round her like a cloak and white with rime.
people.subject: The moment: in a cave of blue glacier ice, she sits very upright and turns only her head toward the viewer; the rest of her stays frozen still. Face: a small, fine-boned, ageless young face, pale as candle wax; very large, still, dark eyes with rime on the lashes; a straight small nose; thin pale lips; a calm without warmth; a faint blue tint at the temples. Hair: black, uncut for two hundred years, wound round and round her body like a cloak, hanging in heavy ropes to the floor, white with rime at the tips, big and plain as the thing the eye sees first. Body: a small woman, sitting straight, shoulders narrow, hands hidden. Clothing: a robe of grey fur gone white with rime, over a white undyed inner robe; a frost-silk sash of long elder's cut gleaming with frost; no jewellery; her hair does most of the clothing. Hands and objects: a small black stone seal in one hand at her breast; at her side a leaning white silk banner with one frost lotus, no writing. Background: a cave of pale-blue glacier plates bound with silver wire; one lamp. Light: cold blue light from the upper left, a faint white glow from the ice. Expression: patient, stubborn, utterly still; a held breath.

people.imagined: A council hall at the seat; the one man who laughs there. He has just told a coast joke, his gourd of coast wine hanging from his wrist, and he laughs loud enough to rattle the pillars.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a long table in a white-pillared hall, he throws back his head in a booming laugh, then turns his big weathered face to the viewer, grinning. Face: a broad, square, deeply weathered face; a wide laughing mouth; thick crows'-feet; small bright blue eyes, shrewd under heavy brows; a big red-brown nose; a short grey-streaked beard; his ice-hole blade, a broad fisher's cutter reforged into a sword, sits in a plain black scabbard, its hilt wrapped in grey sharkskin worn pale; his fisher's hands are huge, red-knuckled, with a pale scar along the left thumb, resting on the table beside a small cup; the light is warm on his face against the cool blue of the room. Hair: black shot with grey, tied in a plain topknot with a leather thong. Body: huge, broad, thick fisher's forearms, big-handed. Clothing: over a plain white elder's robe, a coat of sealskin boiled in its own oil, dark and glossy, open; a frost-silk elder's sash; coast-blue lining at the cuffs; behind him the councillors in white robes and frost-silk sashes look stiff and pained, one covering his ears, while a pale woman at the head of the table has the faintest smile; the hall's pale pillars rise in cold ranks behind him and his laugh seems to rattle them. Hands and objects: a fisher's wine gourd with a rope sling in his right hand, held up at shoulder height; an ice-cutter's broad blade in a black scabbard at his elbow. Background: white pillars of a hall, indistinct councillors. Light: warm light from the upper left; the gourd's rope sling is wound round his wrist and the wine slops slightly as he laughs. Expression: hearty, ambitious, just.

people.imagined: Deep in the Array under the seat she walks by touch from node to node; thin and stooped, hands cold, a frost-silk sash knotted the old way; the pine tea smell clings to her.
people.subject: The moment: in a blue-lit tunnel she presses a carved locust-wood seal to a glowing node, and turns her head to the viewer with a flicker of worry. Face: a thin, honest, deeply lined face, sunken cheeks, high cheekbones; sharp pale grey eyes; a long nose; thin colourless lips set in anxiety; skin like old paper; the locust-wood seal is dark red-brown and worn smooth, a ring of 108 tiny hollows carved round its face; behind her the tunnel's dark walls are scratched with fine chalk marks counting nodes, a lamp hanging, and the light shows her breath as a thin cloud. Hair: white, thin, drawn into a low bun fixed with a plain locust-wood pin. Body: thin, stooped, narrow, her hands bluish with cold; at her hip the polished disc of lake ice in a silver rim glints like a small moon. Clothing: a white elder's robe of fine cloth, frost-silk sash knotted in the old-fashioned way; a round locust-wood shield on her back like a lid, big and plain; woollen mittens under the cuffs. Hands and objects: in her right hand a round locust-wood seal carved with a ring of small nodes; the left laid on a blue stone node; a disc of polished lake ice in silver at her hip; her mittens are grey wool, with the fingers worn at the tips; she smells of pine tea, and a small clay cup of it stands on a ledge beside her, forgotten and cold. Background: a low stone tunnel with a ring of faint blue lights. Light: cold blue light from the stone, from below and left; the Array's node glows a faint steady blue, and as she presses the seal the glow brightens a shade. Expression: cautious, honest to rudeness, waning.

people.imagined: Evening, the anniversary of the fall of Cô Thành. He sits alone with a brush and a white sword on his knees, and he has just written his yearly poem; the plum-blossom scar on his left hand shows.
people.subject: The moment: he sits upright with a white sword lying across his knees and looks up from a sheet of paper toward the viewer, brush in hand. Face: a long, lean, ascetic old face; high forehead; deep lines; sharp brown eyes burning with a low steady fire; a thin straight nose; thin lips pressed; a grey short beard; the plum-blossom scar on the back of his left hand is a perfect five-petalled mark in pale shiny skin. Hair: white, long, tied in a high topknot with a plain white-jade pin. Body: lean, straight, tall, thin-wristed; the cape folded over his shoulder is worn plum-red silk, scorched at one corner, with a lining where a manual was once sewn. Clothing: a plum-white sword robe of fine cloth with a faint plum-blossom pattern in the weave, a frost-silk elder's sash; a worn red-plum cape folded over one shoulder. Hands and objects: on the back of his left hand a scar shaped like a plum blossom, big and plain; a pale blade lying on his lap that gives a faint pink glow; a brush in the right hand; the sword on his lap is a pale blade the colour of milk-glass with a faint pink glow along its edge, and a thin scent of plum blossom is imagined in the air; his poem sheet is blank but for a few brush strokes and his brush is wet; a small clay cup of tea is cold at his knee. Background: a bare room, one lamp, a window of snow; the window behind him shows a dusk of grey snow and a single bare plum branch with one bud; he looks up as one who has been mourning for four hundred years. Light: low evening light from the upper left, a faint pink on the blade. Expression: vengeful, patient, a long mourning.

people.imagined: On the practice floor at the Vessel Hall, she has just finished a form with a sword so clear it looks glazed glass; she counts the five frost stars on her ring before a duel.
people.subject: The moment: she stands with her glass-clear sword raised before her face and looks past the blade at the viewer, perfectly composed. Face: a beautiful, cold, exact face; high clear brow; long almond eyes the colour of lake ice; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth with pale rose lips; her skin is flawless as porcelain; behind her the Vessel Hall's practice floor is polished white stone with a faint blue ring inlaid, and a few younger disciples in white stand in a row watching her with awe; the light is cold and clear, and her gaze is unwavering and without warmth. Hair: black with a blue sheen, in a high smooth knot with a pale ice hairpin. Body: tall, slender, straight; absolutely balanced. Clothing: a white robe of the finest cloth on which characters are brushed in faint frost-ink, fading and white, big and plain, a white sash; a pressed collar; the characters brushed on her white robe in frost-ink are fine and pale, running down the sleeve and across the chest and fading near the cuffs, unreadable as pattern. Hands and objects: a sword of clear glassy ice-like steel held upright; on the left hand a ring set with five tiny frost stars; the sword is clear as glazed glass, so that the white hall shows through it bent and small, the edge a bright line; the ring on her left hand has five tiny white stars set in a ring of ice, and her thumb rests on the fifth. Background: a white hall of pillars. Light: cold clear light from the upper left, the blade's edge glittering. Expression: arrogant, diligent, loyal; unaware of it.

people.imagined: At a go board at the Desert Pavilion, she smiles in public as the only elder who does; sand lies in the folds of her white robe.
people.subject: The moment: she sits at a go board with a white stone between two fingers and smiles warmly at the viewer. Face: a sun-browned, round, kind-sharp face; laugh lines; smiling dark eyes; full lips; a small straight nose; her hands are broad and brown with short nails, and a thin silver ring on one finger; the warm light on her round brown face makes the laugh lines golden; her smile is easy, but her dark eyes are quick and weigh the viewer like a stone. Hair: brown with grey, in a thick plaited coil, a sand-coloured scarf; behind her the sunlit adobe room has a carved wooden screen, a camel-hair rug in red and cream, and a window showing a date palm and a white sky. Body: plump, comfortable, relaxed. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a frost-silk elder's sash and sand caught in the folds of the lap; a light desert shawl; the go board between them is a plain wooden slab with a grid of fine lines and a scatter of black and white stones in an unfinished game, no markings but the lines; sand lies in the folds of her robe's lap in a pale fan and a few grains cling to her sleeve. Hands and objects: a white go stone held between two fingers; a go board with scattered stones before her (no marks); a bowl of black stones is at her elbow and a small porcelain cup of green tea. Background: a sunlit adobe room, the board, a camel rug. Light: warm desert light from the upper left. Expression: gregarious, pragmatic, shrewd.

people.imagined: On the vein ridge in a rising storm, a lightning lash scar from his shoulder to his wrist shows; his left arm twitches.
people.subject: The moment: on the vein ridge in a rising storm he stands with a copper rod beside him and looks calmly at the viewer, the left sleeve pushed up to show a lightning scar from shoulder to wrist, the left arm trembling slightly. Face: a quiet, lined, calm face of fifty-five; deep-set, steady eyes; a short grey-streaked beard. Hair: grey-black, tied back with a leather thong. Body: tall and solid, planted still against the wind. Clothing: a plain white elder's robe of fine cloth belted with a frost-silk sash, the left sleeve pushed up to the shoulder; copper-wire cuffs. Hands and objects: the white branching lightning scar, a pale fern-pattern on tanned skin, running from shoulder to wrist in the foreground; the left hand shaking in a fine tremor that he holds still with the right on a short copper rod whose tip is blackened. Background: the ridge's snow streaked with black rocks, a line of copper rods against a violet-black storm sky, a blue flash briefly lighting the clouds. Light: cold flat storm light from the upper left with a blue flicker on the scarred arm. Expression: a calm, quiet, accepting look, the eyes steady and the mouth at ease, a man who loves the thing that hurts him.

people.imagined: With a white sable across her shoulders so still it is taken for a fur, and a frost wolf at her heel; wiry and wind-burned, smelling of hide and snow.
people.subject: The moment: she strides across the snow with a white sable draped on her shoulders and a frost wolf at her hip, glancing back at the viewer with a quick, bright look. Face: a wiry, wind-burned, weathered face of fifty; bright, sharp eyes the colour of tea; a firm chin; a wide mouth with chapped lips. Hair: black and grey, in a tight braid bound with a leather thong. Body: lean and tough, the stride quick and the glance back impatient. Clothing: a white riding robe of fine cloth with a leather harness across it set with brass rings for leads, and a frost-silk sash; fur boots reaching to the knee; a white sable draped over the shoulders so still that it is taken for a fur, one black bead eye showing. Hands and objects: one hand resting on the head of a big grey-white wolf with a black stripe down its spine and frost in its ruff, amber eyes watching the viewer. Background: a vast snowfield under a pale sky with a line of footprints and a few distant white beasts. Light: cold bright light from the upper left. Expression: a quick, bright, impatient glance with a hint of warmth in the wide mouth, brave and kind, a woman who smells of hide and snow and prefers animals to speeches.

people.imagined: At court he bows exactly as deep as the listener's rank and never deeper; there is ink on his cuff.
people.subject: The moment: he makes a precise, shallow bow toward the viewer and straightens, smiling softly. Face: a neat, smooth, pleasant face; soft brown eyes; a small trimmed moustache; a gentle smile. Hair: black with grey, in a neat scholar's knot; his neat grey-flecked hair is in a scholar's knot pinned with a lacquered pin. Body: medium, upright, well kept; behind him a pale gallery of carved wood and paper screens runs back, with a few envoys in other colours waiting. Clothing: a white envoy's robe of the finest cloth with a pale-blue sash; a black ink stain on the right cuff, small and plain; his white envoy's robe is of the finest cloth with a pale-blue sash tied in a perfect flat knot, and on his right cuff a small black ink stain the size of a coin shows plainly against the white; he carries a thin brush-case at the sash and a rolled map-case under the left arm. Hands and objects: hands folded; a thin brush case at the sash; he bows with his hands folded and his back straight, exactly as deep as the viewer's rank and no deeper; every detail of him is tidy, except the ink. Background: a court gallery; the smile is gentle and a little rehearsed. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, deceitful, patient.

people.imagined: At the Hàn Giao Chử furnace, red-cheeked and sweating in the cold, his robe hanging open; he is counting dice in his palm.
people.subject: The moment: he stands by a roaring red furnace with his robe hanging open, rattling a pair of bone dice in a cupped palm, and grins at the viewer, red-cheeked and sweating in the cold. Face: a flushed, sweating, round face of forty-five; bright, greedy eyes; a bold grin; red cheeks shining with sweat. Hair: black with grey, tied back, loose strands stuck to the forehead, sweat running into the grey. Body: stout and hot-blooded, chest heaving, standing with his feet apart in the furnace glow. Clothing: a bright rust-red alchemist's robe worn open to the waist over a plain shirt soaked at the neck, the only warm colour in the Pavilion; a leather apron tied round his middle; at his belt a ring of small keys and a pouch of pills. Hands and objects: a pair of bone dice rattled in one cupped hand, the thick fingers stained orange and brown with furnace work and one nail black; a ladle in the other hand. Background: the furnace's red mouth roaring behind him, a row of clay pots on a shelf, a cold stone yard with a white fence and, beyond it, the pale slope of Hàn Giao Chử. Light: red furnace glow from the lower left against blue snow-light. Expression: a bold, greedy, sweaty grin with the eyes fixed on the dice, a man who works hard at the furnace and gambles harder.

people.imagined: In summer heat she wears the winter robe her name means; she stands in a stance copied from her master, perfectly still for a full day.
people.subject: The moment: in summer heat she stands in the winter robe her name means, in a stance copied from her master, perfectly still for a full day, eyes level, meeting the viewer's gaze without moving. Face: a grave, pale, serious young face of twenty-four; level dark eyes; fine straight brows; a closed mouth; a single bead of sweat at the temple though she does not blink. Hair: black, long and straight, tied low with a white ribbon. Body: slender, tall and absolutely still. Clothing: the winter robe of undyed white spirit silk, heavy and plain, with a high collar, long sleeves and a faint quilted texture, worn in the heat of summer, with a pale-blue sash; at the sash a small frost seal of white jade carved in a plain pattern. Hands and objects: a plain narrow ice-blue sword held point down in both hands, the blade at rest. Background: a white hall whose wooden floor catches a bright block of summer sun from a window. Light: cold light from the upper left on her, and the summer sun on the floor with her shadow lying unmoving across it as she has stood a whole day. Expression: a calm, closed, stubborn stillness, the eyes unblinking and the mouth shut, a woman who would rather stand in the heat until she drops than move first.

people.imagined: In the corridor, her frost leaves a faint grey stain where it melts; her black eyes do not reflect the lamps.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim corridor she looks at the viewer with black eyes that reflect nothing, holding a needle of black-cored ice between two fingers. Face: a small, pale, delicate face of twenty-six; large pure black eyes that take in the lamp and give back nothing, with no highlight in them; thin dark brows; a small mouth with a faint smile. Hair: black, in a high bun pinned with a plain ice needle. Body: small and light, standing very straight. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash, a faint grey frost-stain along the left cuff where something melted. Hands and objects: the needle, a thin crystal with a dark thread at its heart, between two fingers, a faint grey stain spreading on the ice where her fingertips touch it like breath on glass; at the sash a small black-backed mirror that shows a white face on its front and none behind. Background: a dim corridor of white stone with lamp-niches that burn without reflecting in her eyes. Light: soft lamp light from the upper left, her eyes remaining dark. Expression: a faint, patient, secret smile with a level and unreflecting gaze, the look of someone quietly concealing a purpose and in no hurry to reveal it.

people.imagined: On the lake ice sitting the old Hàn Giang way, singing a fisherman's song under his breath, badly.
people.subject: The moment: he sits cross-legged on the lake ice in the old Hàn Giang way with his back straight, singing a fisherman's song under his breath, badly, an ice gourd in his hand, then grins at the viewer. Face: a tall, easy, sunburnt young face of twenty-four; a wide goofy grin; warm brown eyes; a crooked nose; a thin line of beard. Hair: black, tied back with a cord. Body: tall and long-limbed, sitting upright as an old man of the river would. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash; a fisher's sword in a plain scabbard laid across his knees. Hands and objects: an old gourd, dark with handling and bound at the neck with a thin cord, with a tiny stick figure of a lone fisher with a rod scratched on its side; the fisher's sword, an ice-cutter's blade ground down. Background: the frozen river stretching flat and white to a line of low cottages in Liên Giang with smoke rising. Light: clear, bright light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, open, goofy grin mid-song, the eyes warm and unselfconscious, a brave honest man who knows he is out of tune and does not care.

people.imagined: Copying her master's manual in red ink; her fingers are stained red; a duel in mind.
people.subject: The moment: she looks up from copying her master's manual in red ink with a stare like a drawn blade, a duel already in mind. Face: a sharp-featured, handsome, hard face of thirty-two; fierce dark eyes; thin straight brows; a clean jaw; a thin mouth; a smear of red ink on one cheek. Hair: black, drawn up into a tight topknot held by a plain white pin, with no loose strand anywhere. Body: athletic and upright, with the bearing of a guard captain's daughter, straight-backed and square-shouldered. Clothing: a white sword robe of fine cloth with a plum-red cuff band and a pale-blue sash. Hands and objects: the fingertips stained red with ink; a brush in one hand; her white-hilted sword lying across the desk beside the brush and a small stone of red ink. Background: the plum sword hall, bare and bright, with a wall of racked swords and one empty peg for a red blade. Light: clear, bright light from the upper left, hard on her cheekbones and glinting on the red of the ink. Expression: a fierce, cold, unblinking glare, the jaw clenched and the thin mouth set, a woman who has been wronged and is counting how she will answer it.

people.imagined: A hostage in the Vessel Hall, a sabre scar and a ready laugh; the only warm-coloured robe.
people.subject: The moment: he laughs and raises a drinking cup to the viewer. Face: a handsome, brown, scarred face; a sabre scar across the cheek; a bright laugh; his handsome brown face carries a sabre scar from cheekbone to jaw, whitened with age, and a ready wide laugh showing strong teeth; behind him the pale hall of the Pavilion looks cold, with white-robed disciples glancing at him with curiosity and a small woman with black eyes standing apart, whose gaze he seeks. Hair: black, long, tied back; his black hair is long and tied back with a red cord. Body: broad, relaxed. Clothing: a rich desert-red robe with a dark sash; his rich desert-red robe is the only warm colour in the Vessel Hall, with a dark sash and a gold-stitched collar, a little dusty at the hem. Hands and objects: a wine cup raised; a go stone in the other hand; he is broad and relaxed, sprawled in a seat with a wine cup raised toward the viewer and a white go stone held between the fingers of the other hand; the light is cool from the upper left with a warm gleam on his cup. Background: a hall; he has watched everything for seventy-nine years and smiles anyway. Light: light from the upper left. Expression: patient, vengeful, gregarious.

people.imagined: A round, kind face with frostbitten earlobes, on a solstice night on the mere.
people.subject: The moment: on a solstice night she sits on a folded blanket on the frozen mere beside a paper lantern and looks warmly at the viewer, her breath smoking, with the patient attention of a woman who has remembered every one who walked back. Face: a round, kind face of fifty; the earlobes red, thickened and frostbitten from a hundred solstice nights of cold; soft dark eyes; a gentle, tired smile. Hair: grey, in a low bun. Body: round and settled, sitting with her knees under the blanket. Clothing: a white robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash, and a thick grey wool shawl over it. Hands and objects: a paper lantern at her side; a basket of warm stones and a flask of hot ginger water; her short thick hands chapped from the cold. Background: the vast frozen lake dark under stars, with small figures in white sitting in rows on the ice, each with a lantern. Light: warm lantern glow from below against cold blue night. Expression: a patient, tender, steady smile with soft eyes, the face of a woman who never loses count of the people in her care and gives each of them the same unhurried look.

people.imagined: Brown, freckled, wrapped in three borrowed furs on the frozen mere, talking to a pot of reed.
people.subject: The moment: she looks out of a mound of furs with a hopeful, stubborn face, a small reed pot in her hands. Face: a brown freckled warm face; wide hopeful dark eyes; a nose red with cold; the three furs round her are a grey wolf pelt, a brown goatskin and a white sable collar, borrowed from three different friends, piled to her ears; her warm brown face is freckled by the oasis sun, with wide hopeful dark eyes, a nose red with cold, round cheeks and a wobbling stubborn smile; she sits on the frozen mere of Hàn Giao Chử with her breath smoking and a lantern at her side; behind her a round-faced kind woman nods. Hair: black, braids; her black braids stick out under a fur hat too big for her. Body: small, bundled. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe buried under three different furs. Hands and objects: a small pot with a green oasis reed in it; the oasis reed in its little clay pot is a single slender green stem with two leaves, fresh and bright against the white, held in both hands as if it were a bird. Background: a frozen lake. Light: light from the upper left; the light is a soft lantern glow and a cold blue dusk. Expression: diligent, stubborn, humble.

people.imagined: Heavy harbour anklets she refuses to take off.
people.subject: The moment: in a sunny sandstone yard of the Desert Pavilion she lifts her hem a little to show a heavy silver anklet engraved with small waves, one of a pair she refuses to take off, and smiles warmly at the viewer. Face: a warm, calm, round face of twenty-three; large, dark, gentle eyes; full lips in a warm, unhurried smile. Hair: black, in a plait threaded with bright beads of red and green glass. Body: sturdy and easy, standing with her weight settled, a small bronze bell chiming at her ankle with each breath she shifts. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash tied the harbour way, small bronze bells at the hem; bare brown feet with the toenails painted pale rose. Hands and objects: the hem held between finger and thumb to show the pair of heavy silver anklets, which jingle when she walks. Background: the sunny sandstone yard, a camel kneeling beside a trough, and a stout woman turning toward her in a lifted greeting. Light: warm bright light from the upper left. Expression: a gentle, unhurried, comfortable smile with soft eyes, a girl from the harbour who is at last at home and sure of being welcome.

people.imagined: Reed cuts on both hands, laughing at the well.
people.subject: The moment: at a stone well beside a bed of green oasis reeds she laughs out loud with her head thrown back and holds up both hands to show their palms and fingers criss-crossed with small red reed cuts. Face: a round, happy face of eighteen; bright brown eyes screwed up with laughter; a snub nose; a wide mouth; a smear of green reed-juice across the chin. Hair: brown, tied in a loose knot with a strip of reed. Body: small and quick, bare toes gripping the damp stone beside the well. Clothing: a white outer-disciple robe of fine cloth with green stains at the sleeves from reed juice, the hem tucked up. Hands and objects: both hands raised, cut by the reeds; a clay watering pot at her feet. Background: the well and the green reeds growing in its overflow, and her aunt with a dried lily in her braid drawing a bucket behind her; the sand beyond pale gold. Light: warm light of a sunlit afternoon from the upper left. Expression: a loud, uncontainable, delighted laugh, the eyes shut tight and the whole face open, a girl who cannot hold a laugh in and would share a cut finger as readily as a joke.

people.imagined: Camel dust in his eyebrows, training with a wooden sword.
people.subject: The moment: in a camel yard he swings a wooden practice sword with a grunt and glances at the viewer, dust in his eyebrows. Face: a blunt, brave face of twenty-six; a heavy jaw; small dark eyes; a broad nose; a faint clean line of sweat cutting through the dust on his temple. Hair: black, cropped close to the scalp and sandy with dust, a few dark curls stuck damp to the forehead. Body: broad and thick-armed, his sunburnt arms swelling with the swing, a stance that says he has no intention of ever sitting on a frozen lake. Clothing: a white riding robe of fine cloth cut short, grey with dust to the knee, tied with a leather belt. Hands and objects: a wooden sword notched along the edge by a hundred drills, gripped in both big hands with the knuckles pale and the wrists thick as a post. Background: a ring of trodden sand with wooden posts, a water barrel and a row of kneeling camels, with a bow-legged teacher with a missing tooth watching. Light: bright, hard light from the upper left with a haze of dust rising. Expression: a blunt, stubborn, eager look, the jaw set and the eyes narrowed with glee at the fight, a brave young man who loves a drill the way others love a feast.

people.imagined: Straw in her braid and a horse's patient stare.
people.subject: The moment: she stands holding a horse's rope with straw in her braid, her patient face mirroring the horse's patient stare, as it nuzzles her shoulder. Face: a calm, plain, brown face of nineteen; calm dark eyes; a broad nose; a wide, quiet mouth; the bay's breath puffing warm at her neck as she stands unmoving. Hair: brown, in one long braid threaded with straw. Body: sturdy and broad in the hip, her weight settled evenly on both feet, standing very still as one does beside a horse that startles easily, shoulders loose. Clothing: a plain brown servant's tunic, clean and belted with a cord, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, smelling of hay and horse; old leather gloves tucked in at the waist. Hands and objects: the rope held loosely in one hand; the other resting on the horse's cheek; the horse a dusty bay with a white star. Background: a low mud-brick stable with an open door and a dim hayloft above, a bucket and a pitchfork leaning against the wall. Light: the long golden light of late afternoon from the upper left. Expression: a patient, calm, unassuming look, the eyes steady and the mouth quiet, a girl who has no Water at all and came anyway, says she does not count, and is simply glad to be among horses.

people.imagined: Tending the furnace with his eyebrows singed off, unable to stand still.
people.subject: The moment: he bounces on his toes by a roaring furnace and grins, one heel tapping, holding an iron poker in both hands like a spear. Face: a bright, eager, round face of twenty-one with no eyebrows, the brow bare where they were singed off once and never regrew, giving him a permanently startled look; bright eyes and a wide grin lit orange. Hair: black, spiky and tufted. Body: wiry and restless, unable to stand still, the snow outside blue behind him and himself in a pool of warm red light. Clothing: a plain brown furnace-boy's tunic and a leather apron, scorched at the hem and with a patch of ash on the chest, the sleeves rolled to the elbow. Hands and objects: an iron poker held across the body in both hands; a smear of ash on one forearm. Background: the furnace outside the array where flame is allowed roaring behind him, a pile of charcoal sacks beside it, and a thin quiet man in a leather apron feeding wood. Light: red furnace glow from below, with cold blue light at the doorway. Expression: an excited, startled-looking, wide grin with the bare brow lifted, a brave, talkative lad who is delighted by fire and by everyone who comes near it.

people.imagined: Hands bleached white and wrinkled to the wrist; she washes four hundred robes in warmed water.
people.subject: The moment: she lifts both white, wrinkled hands from a tub of steaming water and looks tiredly at the viewer, the hands bleached and wrinkled to the wrist like a drowned woman's; she has found a Wood breath of her own in the steam. Face: a patient, thin, tired face of forty; gentle dark eyes ringed with shadow; a small mouth; a faint flush of steam at the cheekbones. Hair: brown, tied up under a plain cloth with damp wisps curling at the temples from the steam. Body: thin and slightly bent from the tub, the shoulders rounded forward and the weight on one hip, standing the way someone does after bending over water for hours. Clothing: a servant's plain, coarse, undyed tunic, clean and dark with damp at the sleeves and lap, with a rough apron and bare red forearms. Hands and objects: both hands raised in the foreground, bleached white and wrinkled to the wrists, water running from the fingertips. Background: a washing yard with lines of white robes hanging in rows like pale ghosts, steam rising from tubs, and a thin young man sweeping. Light: bright snow-light of morning through steam from the upper left. Expression: a tired, gentle, uncomplaining look, the eyes soft and the mouth at rest, a woman humble and kind who has long since stopped expecting thanks.

people.imagined: His palms are always warm and steam in the winter air.
people.subject: The moment: he holds out both steaming hands to the viewer and smiles; he was sent up from the fishing village at ten to carry water and it turned out he could warm it with his hands. Face: a trusting, rosy, round-cheeked boy's face of seventeen; bright brown eyes; a wide, open smile; the cheeks pink from the warmth of his own hands. Hair: black, cut short and neat. Body: slight and narrow-shouldered, standing eagerly forward. Clothing: a servant's plain undyed tunic of coarse white cloth, clean and belted with a cord, the sleeves rolled up, with a grey cloth apron. Hands and objects: both palms red and steaming in thin curls in the cold air, held out toward the viewer; a thin curl of steam also rising from the sleeve ends. Background: a kitchen with a row of cauldrons, a copper kettle on a stone ledge beside him, a round-shouldered tea master pouring for someone he fancies, and a girl with a tray. Light: warm kitchen light from the upper left with steam catching it. Expression: a trusting, hopeful, wide-open smile with bright eyes, a diligent boy who is shyly proud of the one strange gift he has and eager to be of use.

people.imagined: A perfectly still face with one tiny line between the brows she is proud of; she has turned her back on a weeping friend.
people.subject: The moment: she has just turned her back on a friend who wept at the lake, and looks back over her shoulder at the viewer with no expression at all. Face: a smooth, pale face of eighteen; cool light eyes; a straight nose; a small closed mouth; a single tiny line between the brows that she is proud of. Hair: black, drawn into a neat bun pinned with a white pin, smooth and exact, with not a single hair out of line. Body: slim and upright, shoulders squared and the spine straight, the neck turned just far enough to look back and the rest of her turned decisively away. Clothing: a faultlessly pressed white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth with narrow sleeves and a pale-blue sash. Hands and objects: her slim hands folded before her, not a finger out of place. Background: the white hall of the Pavilion, with a weeping girl with red eyes small and blurred at the edge of the frame. Light: cold, even light from the upper left. Expression: a perfectly still, cool, smooth face with a tiny line between the brows and no feeling in the eyes, a girl who is taking the Ice Heart too literally and is proud of how well she does it.

people.imagined: Grinding red ink, cuffs stained red, back hunched.
people.subject: The moment: he grinds a stick of red ink on a dark stone slab and looks up; he has learned the forms from the margins. Face: a patient, mild, honest young face of twenty-five; brown eyes; a snub nose; an ink-smudged cheek. Hair: black, tied back with a plain cloth, a few stray strands falling over a brow where he has pushed it back with an inky wrist. Body: hunched, the back-line rounded from years of grinding, sitting low on a stool with his elbows close and his forearms moving in a slow, practised circle. Clothing: a clean white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth with cuffs stained red to the elbow. Hands and objects: slender fingers stained red under the nails, working the ink-stick on the stone; beside him a brush-rest and a small porcelain water-dropper. Background: the quiet hall with a long table of copied leaves of the manual drying under pebble weights, a woman with a red thumbnail writing at the end of it, and a plain wooden sword hanging on the wall. Light: soft warm light from the upper left, with a red tint on the ink. Expression: a mild, honest, patient look just lifted from his work, the eyes calm and the mouth soft, a diligent man who asks nothing and does the task before him.

people.imagined: Owl feathers behind one ear, unblinking pale eyes.
people.subject: The moment: he stares unblinking at the viewer with a small white sable curled in the crook of his arm; he was raised by snow-owl trappers on the tundra and talks more to sables than to people. Face: a pale, still, lean face of twenty-two; pale unblinking eyes; a thin straight nose; a quiet mouth. Hair: dark, long and tied back, with two owl feathers, brown and cream barred, tucked behind one ear. Body: lean and tall, as still as a post, the shoulders narrow and the arms held close, standing with the patience of a man who has waited in snow for animals to come to him. Clothing: a white riding robe of fine cloth, plain, with a pale-blue sash and a leather harness. Hands and objects: the small white sable curled in the crook of one arm, stroked by two fingers of the other hand. Background: a vast, almost empty white tundra under a pale sky, and at its edge a big white-maned ice wolf with a lazy rider waiting. Light: cold, bright, flat light from the upper left. Expression: a pale, steady, unblinking gaze and a mouth at rest, a quiet young man who is brave without showing it and has little to say to anyone who is not furred.

people.imagined: Hair standing on end near the rods, placing each foot as if testing it.
people.subject: The moment: on the ridge he stands carefully with his hair on end, placing each foot as if testing it, and looks warily at the viewer; he has twice been knocked flat. Face: a wary, thin face of twenty-six; dark eyes ringed with sleeplessness; a pinched mouth; a long nose. Hair: black, every strand lifted straight from the scalp like the bristles of a brush, the ends faintly glowing blue where the air crackles. Body: thin and long-limbed, caught mid-stride on the balls of his feet with his weight held back, the shoulders drawn up around his ears as if the sky might fall. Clothing: a white inner-disciple robe of fine cloth with a pale-blue sash and the cuffs wound with copper wire. Hands and objects: a copper rod taller than himself held upright in one hand, with an oiled-cloth wrap round the grip. Background: the ridge crowded with copper rods against a black-violet sky with a branching blue fork of lightning, and a woman with her head tilted listening. Light: flat, cold light from the upper left with a blue flicker. Expression: a wary, tense, watchful look, the eyes wide and the mouth pinched, a careful man who has learned what the sky can do.

people.imagined: Dark circles under her eyes; the lamp never trembles.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone tunnel under the seat she holds a steady cold-light lamp, a small pale glass globe giving a blue-white glow that never trembles in her hand, and looks tiredly at the viewer, having noticed the damp sleeves. Face: a tired, careful face of twenty-four with dark circles under large, grave eyes; a straight small nose; a patient mouth. Hair: black, in a bun pinned with a plain pin, a few strands loosened by the long shift. Body: small and slight, standing very still so as not to shake the light. Clothing: a clean white junior disciple's robe of fine cloth belted with a plain cord, with chalk dust on the hem and one sleeve damp. Hands and objects: the cold-light globe held at chest height in one hand, steady, its glow lighting her fingers from below. Background: a stone tunnel receding under the seat with a ring of faint blue lights, and a stooped man with damp knees coming up out of a shaft. Light: cold blue-white light from the lamp, from below and the left. Expression: a tired, watchful, careful look, the eyes large and grave and the mouth patient, a humble girl who sees everything in the damp and says nothing until she is sure.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder: a slight scholar in southern grey with a jade vessel at the waist and ink on her wrist.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of the founder standing in a desert pass holding a small jade vessel in both hands and looking quietly at the viewer. Face: a slight, scholarly, calm face of about sixty; thoughtful dark eyes; a fine nose; a small composed mouth with a faint look of poetry in it; the silk cracked in fine lines and browned at the corners. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a scholar's knot with a plain jade pin. Body: slight and upright. Clothing: a robe of southern grey silk with wide sleeves and a plain sash, a small jade vessel hung at the waist; ink on her right wrist. Hands and objects: a small jade vessel held in both hands, a piece of ice inside it that has not melted. Background: a pale desert falling away to a far horizon where a white line of distant ice shines, rendered in soft brown wash like the rest of the silk. Light: a soft faded gold, as of old pigment. Expression: a calm, patient, quietly ambitious look, the eyes level and the mouth composed, a scholar who has already seen the far ice and means to bring a piece of it home.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of a plum-blossom swordsman who rode out and did not return.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened: a plum-blossom swordsman who rode out and did not return stands looking at the viewer. Face: a lean, brave, honest face of about thirty-five; dark eyes; a straight nose; a firm mouth with a faint smile; a sword scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, tied up in a topknot, with a few loose strands at the temples. Body: lean and tall, upright, shoulders squared, one hand at his side as if the ride had not yet begun. Clothing: a plum-red sword robe of fine cloth with long sleeves, a plain sash, and a high collar, the red softened by age to a dusty rose.
